name: Lisa’s Plot
subtitle: A forbidden love, a hidden child, and a death sentence
description: Lisa — Jaiden’s biological mother, a demon who gave up her child to protect him. Her story is one of sacrifice, guilt, and the price of defying divine law.

fields.label: The Vow Break
fields.value: Lisa was a Bloodward-rank demon stationed in the Human Realm on a covert mission. She fell in love with Ordium, an Aetherblade Lord Angel. When she became pregnant, the Demon Pact she was bound by was broken — not through betrayal, but through love. She did not trigger a Sanctuary Break because the break was not through deliberate betrayal of someone she swore to protect. Instead, she became a Fallen Angel with full sanity intact.

fields.label: The Sacrifice
fields.value: Lisa gave Jaiden to her personal maid, Sofia Marlock, and sent them both to the Human Realm. She sealed his hybrid auras with the Auralis Ruby so he would appear human. Sofia raised him as her own in the Human Realm, hiding his true nature. Lisa stayed behind in the Demon Realm, knowing that if anyone discovered his hybrid nature, both he and she would be hunted.

fields.label: Her Death
fields.value: Lisa died when Jaiden was 8 — killed by Licent Varak’s men after he reported her relationship with an angel. Her death is the defining trauma of Jaiden’s life. Sofia Marlock found Jaiden hiding in the ruins and took him in, giving him her surname to protect him.

fields.label: Her Ghost (Books 6-9)
fields.value: Lisa appears as a spiritual echo in the Sealed Writings — not truly alive, but a recorded consciousness left by the Aelthar. She guides Jaiden through understanding his hybrid nature. Her final message: "You are not broken. You are both." This becomes Jaiden’s mantra.

fields.label: Story Relevance
fields.value: Lisa is the emotional core of Jaiden’s motivation. Her sacrifice, her love, and her death drive everything he does. She represents the possibility that love transcends realm boundaries — the same choice Jaiden will eventually face.

name: Licent Varak’s Plot
subtitle: Jealousy that cost Lisa her life
description: Licent Varak — Tera Morage’s second-in-command, secretly working with Dark Moon. His arc is one of ambition, betrayal, and death.

fields.label: Rise to Power
fields.value: Licent is a Bloodward-rank demon who rose through Tera Morage’s ranks through cunning and ruthless efficiency. He is the second most powerful demon in the realm. He genuinely believes he should rule — Tera is too rigid, too honor-bound, too predictable. He wants to modernize the demon realm through trade and alliances, not just warfare.

fields.label: Dark Moon Alliance (Books 1-8)
fields.value: Wener Leger approached Licent years ago with a deal: Dark Moon helps Licent seize the Mordrach throne, in exchange for control of the demon military after the Fourth Turning. Bound by a Demon Pact. Licent feeds Wener intelligence about demon movements and angel vulnerabilities. He does not know Wener plans to discard him.

fields.label: The Hybrid Discovery
fields.value: Licent is the one who first reports Jaiden’s hybrid nature to Tera Morage. He sees the hybrid as a weapon — someone who can be controlled and used against the angels. He does not understand the prophecy or the stakes. He sees politics where there are existential threats.

fields.label: Death (Book 12)
fields.value: During the Fourth Turning, Licent acts impulsively. He tries to kill weakened Tera to seize power without Wener’s authorization. Tera kills him with her bare hands. His death is anticlimactic — an ambitious man who played a game too big for him. Wener feels nothing. The tool broke.

fields.label: Story Relevance
fields.value: Licent is the cautionary tale of ambition without vision. He wanted power but did not understand what he was power over. His death shows the cost of playing both sides without understanding the stakes.

name: Ordium’s Plot
subtitle: Love at first sight — left unfinished
description: The tragedy of Ordium — Jaiden’s biological father, an angel who fell in love with a demon. His story is told through flashbacks and the consequences he left behind.

fields.label: Backstory
fields.value: Ordium was an Aetherblade Lord Angel, the First Pillar who left the Angel Realm for love. He was tasked with defending the Angel Realm. Instead, he fell in love with Lisa, a Bloodward-rank demon on a covert mission. Their affair produced Jaiden — a hybrid. When the Angel hierarchy discovered Lisa’s pregnancy, Ordium was captured and executed by Clint Ashborn personally.

fields.label: The Flashback Arc (Books 2, 5, 8)
fields.value: Ordium’s story is told in fragmented flashbacks triggered by Jaiden discovering his demonic side. Each flashback reveals more: his genuine love for Lisa, his horror at what the angel hierarchy does, his attempt to defect, his final moments before execution. The flashbacks parallel Jaiden’s own struggles with dual nature.

fields.label: His Legacy
fields.value: Ordium left behind three things: the Auralis Ruby (sealed into Jaiden to hide his hybrid nature), a hidden journal in the Sealed Writings, and a blood debt with Tera Morage that she still calls in. His death created a power vacuum in the Bloodward rank that Licent Varak now fills.

fields.label: Thematic Role
fields.value: Ordium represents the cost of forbidden love across realm boundaries. He is the reason Jaiden exists — and the reason the world is afraid of him. His story asks: can an angel truly love? The answer drives Jaiden’s whole arc.

name: Jaiden Marlock — Normal
subtitle: First Form of 5 — Jaiden Marlock
description: The form Jaiden lives in every day — sealed by the Auralis Ruby. He looks fully human: no wings, no horns, no halo. His angelic and demonic auras are completely suppressed, and his Veyn signature reads as a baseline human. This is the form Sofia raised him in, the form his friends know, and the form he is most comfortable in — because it is the only form where he feels like he belongs.

fields.label: Seal
fields.value: All 5 seals active — the Auralis Ruby suppresses both angelic and demonic auras completely

fields.label: Visual
fields.value: Lean young man, ~15. Dark hair past ears, grey eyes. Auralis Ruby pendant at throat. No wings, horns, or halo. Occasionally his veins glow faintly gold or violet when seals strain, but this is subtle.

fields.label: Abilities
fields.value: Normal human capabilities plus whatever Mage skills he has learned. No access to angelic or demonic powers. Veyn channeling works normally for his grade (3rd Circle Rune Star).

fields.label: Aura
fields.value: None visible — both angelic and demonic auras are fully suppressed by the Ruby

fields.label: Trigger
fields.value: Default state — this is what he reverts to when not transformed

fields.label: Cost
fields.value: None — this is the baseline. The seals do the work of suppression automatically.

fields.label: Duration
fields.value: Permanent until a seal is voluntarily released

fields.label: Risk
fields.value: If the seals are stressed (extreme emotion, combat, proximity to strong Veyn sources), the Ruby grows warm and his veins may flicker. This is how others might notice something is wrong.

fields.label: Story Role
fields.value: The form of normalcy Jaiden clings to. Every time he leaves this form, he risks exposure. The tension between hiding and revealing is the core of his early arc.

fields.label: Lore Connections
fields.value: Auralis Ruby, Sofia Marlock, Elyndor Academy, first impressions with Bella/Mark/Eva

name: Jaiden Marlock — Halo & Horns
subtitle: Fourth Form of 5 — Jaiden Marlock
description: The first seal release. A halo appears above his head and two horns emerge from his forehead, using partial abilities of both an angel and a demon. This is the form Jaiden discovers first — the least dangerous transformation, and the one that teaches him what he truly is. It is also the form that nearly exposes him at the Academy.

fields.label: Seal
fields.value: 1st seal released — the weakest seal, easiest to break and easiest to restore

fields.label: Visual
fields.value: A faint golden halo flickers above his head, uneven and uncertain — not the steady glow of an angel. Two small horns curve from his forehead, dark and smooth, barely more than bumps. His eyes may shift — one flickering gold, one violet — but not permanently. His aura is a thin, unstable mix of angelic warmth and demonic chill.

fields.label: Abilities
fields.value: Partial access to both angelic and demonic skills — weaker versions of each. Can channel small amounts of Holy Energy and Corrupted Veyn simultaneously. Angelic Aura (Lumen-level, barely perceptible) and Demonic Aura (Gnash-level, unsettling presence). Can sense both holy and corrupted Veyn in the environment.

fields.label: Aura
fields.value: Thin, unstable — a mix of angelic warmth and demonic chill that makes people nearby feel uneasy without knowing why

fields.label: Trigger
fields.value: Voluntary release of the 1st seal — Jaiden must consciously choose to let the seal crack. Can also be triggered by extreme emotional stress (fear, anger, desperation) if the seal is already weakened.

fields.label: Cost
fields.value: The strain passes to the 2nd seal, weakening it slightly. Jaiden feels a headache and mild nausea. The longer he holds this form, the more the strain accumulates.

fields.label: Duration
fields.value: Sustainable for minutes to hours depending on seal condition. First time: barely 30 seconds. After training: up to 2 hours.

fields.label: Risk
fields.value: If held too long, the 2nd seal may crack prematurely, forcing an uncontrolled transition to Full Angel or Full Demon form. The unstable aura can be detected by anyone with strong Veyn sensitivity — Diviners, high-rank angels, high-rank demons.

fields.label: Story Role
fields.value: The form of revelation — Jaiden first sees himself as he truly is. It is both liberating and terrifying. This form nearly exposes him at the Academy and forces Kael von Ashen to reveal the truth.

fields.label: Lore Connections
fields.value: Auralis Ruby seal chain, angelic/demonic aura mixing, Kael von Ashen's observation, Bella Rose's Veyn surge response

name: Jaiden Marlock — Full Angel Form
subtitle: Second Form of 5 — Jaiden Marlock
description: The second seal release. 6 pure feathery white wings and a halo that glows brightly on top of his head, along with the angelic aura all angels carry. This form is identical to an Aetherblade Lord Angel — the same wing count, the same halo brightness, the same aura strength. To anyone watching, Jaiden looks like a high-ranking angel. This is the form that proves he inherited his father's full power.

fields.label: Seal
fields.value: 2nd seal released — significantly stronger than the 1st, harder to break and restore

fields.label: Visual
fields.value: 6 pure white feathery wings that glow with a steady light, bearing faint battle-scars (inherited from Ordium's bloodline). A bright, steady halo — not as dazzling as a Serapharch's but unmistakably Aetherblade Lord level. His features sharpen, his posture straightens, and his eyes become fully gold. He looks like a warrior angel, battle-ready and imposing.

fields.label: Abilities
fields.value: Full access to Aetherblade Lord Angel skills: Skyward Chains, Vanguard's Cry, Aegis Ward, Holy Mend, Angelic Aura (Aetherblade), Swiftstep, Dawnveil (Aetherblade). Channels pure Holy Energy. Can fly at angel speeds. His angelic aura is strong enough to make weaker beings want to bow.

fields.label: Aura
fields.value: Strong angelic aura — identical to an Aetherblade Lord Angel. Makes weaker beings feel an instinctive urge to submit. Angels nearby will recognize it as genuine.

fields.label: Trigger
fields.value: Voluntary release of the 2nd seal. The 1st seal must already be released (or bypassed). Can also be triggered by extreme emotional stress if both lower seals are weakened.

fields.label: Cost
fields.value: Significant strain on the 3rd seal. Jaiden feels a burning sensation across his back (where the wings emerge) and a pressure in his skull (where the halo forms). His demonic half is completely suppressed — no access to demonic skills or Corrupted Veyn while in this form.

fields.label: Duration
fields.value: Sustainable for minutes depending on seal condition. First time: barely 10 seconds. After training: up to 30 minutes. Longer usage risks cracking the 3rd seal.

fields.label: Risk
fields.value: The 3rd seal may crack, forcing an uncontrolled transition to Full Demon form (the seals cascade). Angels who see this form will assume Jaiden is an angel — which means they will eventually discover he is not, creating a political crisis. Also suppresses his demonic half entirely, which means he loses access to half his abilities.

fields.label: Story Role
fields.value: The form of proof — Jaiden can be an angel. He can pass. He can belong in the Angel Realm. But passing means denying his demonic half, and that denial is its own kind of prison. This form forces the question: is it better to be accepted as half of what you are, or rejected as all of what you are?

fields.label: Lore Connections
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord Angel rank, Ordium's bloodline, angelic aura, Holy Energy channeling, Dawnveil, Angel Realm politics

name: Jaiden Marlock — Full Demon Form
subtitle: Third Form of 5 — Jaiden Marlock
description: The third seal release. 6 horns and 6 dark purple feathery wings, along with the demonic aura all demons carry. This form is identical to a Bloodward demon — the same horn count, the same wing color, the same aura strength. To anyone watching, Jaiden looks like a high-ranking demon. This is the form that proves he inherited his mother's full power.

fields.label: Seal
fields.value: 3rd seal released — very strong, difficult to break and very difficult to restore

fields.label: Visual
fields.value: 6 horns curling from his forehead, sharp and jagged, some cracked (inherited from Lisa's bloodline). 6 dark purple feathery wings, broad and scarred, carrying battle-marks. His skin takes on a faint violet undertone, his eyes become fully violet, and his features sharpen into something predatory. A dark, ominous aura surrounds him — the demonic miasma that makes weaker beings want to kneel.

fields.label: Abilities
fields.value: Full access to Bloodward demon skills: Blood Chains, Warcry of Dominion, Crimson Ward, Blood Pact, Veyn Decomposition (Bloodward), Demonic Aura (Bloodward), Berserk (Bloodward), Duskveil (Bloodward). Channels Corrupted Veyn. Can fly at demon speeds. His demonic aura is strong enough to make weaker beings want to submit. Demons who see this form will recognize it as genuine.

fields.label: Aura
fields.value: Strong demonic aura — identical to a Bloodward demon. Makes weaker beings feel an instinctive urge to submit. The aura has a chilling, oppressive quality that makes the air feel heavy.

fields.label: Trigger
fields.value: Voluntary release of the 3rd seal. Lower seals must already be released (or bypassed). Can also be triggered by extreme emotional stress if lower seals are weakened.

fields.label: Cost
fields.value: Heavy strain on the 4th seal. Jaiden feels a cold burn across his back (wings), a splitting pressure in his skull (horns), and a nauseating surge of dark energy. His angelic half is completely suppressed — no access to angelic skills or Holy Energy while in this form.

fields.label: Duration
fields.value: Sustainable for seconds to minutes depending on seal condition. First time: barely 5 seconds. After training: up to 15 minutes. Longer usage risks cracking the 4th seal.

fields.label: Risk
fields.value: The 4th seal may crack, forcing an uncontrolled transition to True Hybrid Form — the most dangerous outcome. Demons who see this form will either try to recruit him or kill him, depending on their rank and agenda. Also suppresses his angelic half entirely.

fields.label: Story Role
fields.value: The form of denial — Jaiden can be a demon. He can pass in the Demon Realm. He can survive among demons. But passing means denying his angelic half, and that denial costs him the ability to use Holy Energy — the one thing that can heal corruption. This form forces the question: is it better to survive as half of what you are, or die as all of what you are?

fields.label: Lore Connections
fields.value: Bloodward demon rank, Lisa's bloodline, demonic aura, Corrupted Veyn channeling, Duskveil, Demon Realm politics, Berserk

name: Jaiden Marlock — True Hybrid Form
subtitle: Fifth Form of 5 — Jaiden Marlock
description: The fifth and final seal release. 3 pure white feathery wings on one half of his body and 3 black feathery wings on the other, 6 horns, and a halo split in half floating above his head. Both the angelic and demonic auras surround him at the same time. This form has never existed before — no one has ever seen a being that carries both natures simultaneously. It is the form the Prophecy of the Half-Made was written about.

fields.label: Seal
fields.value: 5th seal released — the strongest seal, the final barrier. Once broken, it cannot be restored by normal means.

fields.label: Visual
fields.value: 3 pure white feathery wings on his left side, glowing with Holy Energy. 3 black feathery wings on his right side, shimmering with Corrupted Veyn. 6 horns curling from his forehead — the left 3 smooth and golden-tipped, the right 3 jagged and dark. A halo split in half floats above his head: the left half is a solid ring of golden light (angelic), the right half is a cracked ring of dark violet energy (demonic). His eyes are heterochromatic — left eye gold, right eye violet. Both auras surround him simultaneously, creating a pressure that makes the air feel heavy and the light flicker. He looks like a god of two natures, neither fully light nor fully dark.

fields.label: Abilities
fields.value: All Aetherblade Lord Angel skills AND all Bloodward demon skills available simultaneously. Both Holy Energy and Corrupted Veyn can be channeled at once. In this form, his skills FUSE — each angel skill merges with its demonic counterpart to create a hybrid skill that neither race could wield alone. Hybrid skills include: Twilight Chains, Cry of the Sundered, Hollow Aegis, Mend-and-Rot, Aura of the Split Crown, Frenzied Step, Gloaming Veil. Can fly. Both angelic and demonic auras are active at full strength.

fields.label: Aura
fields.value: Dual aura — angelic warmth and demonic chill simultaneously. The effect is overwhelming: weaker beings feel pulled in two directions at once, wanting to both bow and flee. The air crackles with conflicting Veyn. Light sources flicker. Shadows move wrong. This aura has never been seen before, and anyone who witnesses it will never forget it.

fields.label: Skill Fusion
fields.value: Each Aetherblade Lord skill fuses with its Bloodward counterpart: Skyward Chains + Blood Chains = Twilight Chains; Vanguard's Cry + Warcry of Dominion = Cry of the Sundered; Aegis Ward + Crimson Ward = Hollow Aegis; Holy Mend + Veyn Decomposition = Mend-and-Rot; Angelic Aura + Demonic Aura = Aura of the Split Crown; Swiftstep + Berserk = Frenzied Step; Dawnveil + Duskveil = Gloaming Veil.

fields.label: Trigger
fields.value: Voluntary release of the 5th seal — requires all lower seals to be released or broken. Can also be triggered involuntarily if all 5 seals break simultaneously (emotional overload, physical damage to the Ruby, or the Ruby being destroyed).

fields.label: Cost
fields.value: Extreme. The body is not designed to hold both natures simultaneously. Jaiden feels searing pain across his entire body — every Veyn channel burns, every nerve fires. His vision blurs. His thoughts fragment. The longer he holds this form, the more his body deteriorates. After extended use, he collapses and cannot use any form for days.

fields.label: Duration
fields.value: Extremely limited. First time: barely 2 seconds before the pain forces him out. After training: up to 5 minutes maximum. Holding it longer risks permanent damage to his Veyn channels — or death.

fields.label: Risk
fields.value: The Ruby may shatter entirely if the form is held too long, making the transformation permanent and irreversible. His body may not survive the strain — the incompatibility between Holy Energy and Corrupted Veyn could tear his Veyn channels apart. Even if he survives, prolonged use could leave him unable to use any form ever again. And every person who witnesses this form becomes a potential threat — the political fallout of a being like this existing is incalculable.

fields.label: Story Role
fields.value: The form of truth — this is what Jaiden really is. Not angel, not demon, not human, but all three. It is the form the prophecy describes, the form every faction fears, and the form Jaiden must learn to control before the fourth turning. It is also the form he must ultimately sacrifice — not because it is evil, but because the only way to mend the Sundering is to give up what makes him unique.

fields.label: Lore Connections
fields.value: Prophecy of the Half-Made, Hybrid Fusion, Hybrid Skills, Sundering Prophecy Cycle, World Core response, Auralis Ruby destruction, fourth turning, mending vs silence choice

name: Angel Skills
subtitle: The skills of angels
description: The abilities angels wield, drawn from their Veyn and their rank. Each angel rank has its own skills, and the Six Pillars of Angels each carry their own personal techniques. Titles also grant their own set of skills, distinct from rank abilities.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Angel-exclusive active and passive skills unlocked through rank progression and the Vow system.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: Drawn from Holy Energy channeled through the angel Vow to the World Core.

fields.label: Progression
fields.value: New skills unlock at each rank: Lumen (basic), Virtue (intermediate), Aetherblade Lord (advanced), Serapharch (ultimate).

name: Kings Record
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: By making physical contact, the user can view fragments of a target's memories and past experiences. The clearer the contact and the stronger the user's focus, the more detailed the visions become.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Serapharch Ultimate — Holy Augmentation

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The angel inscribes a divine decree into reality. All allies within range receive a massive buff: +50% Veyn capacity, +30% damage, immunity to Corrupted Veyn for 60 seconds. Enemies within range are weakened: -30% Veyn regeneration.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 180 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Serapharch only

name: Sixth Sense
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Sharpens every one of the user's senses far beyond normal limits. Sight can pierce darkness and illusion, hearing can catch heartbeats and distant footsteps, smell can track individuals across long distances, and touch can feel shifts in Veyn and emotion. At full focus, the user can perceive things that are completely invisible to the naked eye, including hidden auras, faint traces of magic, and the emotional state of those nearby.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Passive — Precognitive Awareness

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Grants instinctive danger detection. The angel perceives attacks 0.5 seconds before they happen, allowing automatic evasion of the first hit in any combat encounter.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: None (passive)

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: C-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: All angel ranks

name: Time Reversal
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Reverses the flow of time in a small area or on a single target for up to 20 seconds, undoing recent actions or injuries within that window.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Serapharch Active — Temporal Manipulation

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Reverses time in a localized area by up to 3 seconds. All actions, movements, and Veyn expenditures within the zone are undone. Cannot reverse death or irreversible corruption.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 300 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Serapharch only

name: Chronos Fury
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Calls down a concentrated storm of lightning onto a chosen location, striking with high precision and destructive force.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Serapharch Active — Temporal Strike

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The angel attacks with weaponized time, aging the target area by centuries in an instant. Deals massive Holy Energy damage and temporarily ages the target, reducing their physical stats by 40% for 30 seconds.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 120 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Serapharch only

name: Will Mastery
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Shapes pure Veyn into any weapon the user can imagine. The formed weapons can also launch sharp blades of compressed air from a distance.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Passive — Mental Fortitude

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The angel immune to charm, fear, and mind-control effects. Veyn capacity increases by 10% per rank above Virtue.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: None (passive)

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Virtue and above

name: Holy Rain
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Summons a rain of purified holy energy that burns undead and corrupted beings while healing allies and restoring their Veyn.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord Active — Area Healing

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: A rain of Holy Energy falls over a wide area, healing all allies for 40% of max Veyn over 10 seconds. Also cleanses one negative status effect per tick.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 60 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: A-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord and above

name: Dignified Presence
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: The user floods the surrounding area with their own Veyn, thickening the air until it becomes heavy and oppressive. Breathing grows difficult, movement slows, and weaker opponents struggle to stay upright or form skills. The more Veyn the user pours into it, the denser and more crushing the pressure becomes.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Passive — Aura Enhancement

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The angel’s natural aura intimidates weaker beings. Enemies below the angel’s grade have a 20% chance to hesitate on their first attack. Allies within 10 meters gain +10% morale and Veyn regeneration.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: None (passive)

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Virtue and above

name: Angelic Aura (Serapharch)
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: A constant, overwhelming presence that presses down on anyone weaker. It strips away the will to resist, making targets feel an instinctive urge to bow or submit. Even strong opponents feel their resolve weaken under its weight.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Active — Divine Domain

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Expands the angel’s aura into a 30-meter dome. Allies within gain +30% all stats. Enemies within take continuous Holy Energy damage and have their Corrupted Veyn sealed.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 90 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Serapharch only

name: Holy Flame
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: A signature skill of the Serapharch: flames made from pure holy energy that burn corruption on contact. Unlike Purgatory Flames, which simply burns until released, Holy Flame actively consumes anything tied to corrupted Veyn — demons, undead, or miasma take heavy damage from it, while anything untouched by corruption barely feels it. One of the few things capable of matching Purgatory Flames head-on; the two effectively cancel each other out if they clash directly.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Serapharch Active — Consecrated Fire

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Summons a pillar of divine fire that burns for 8 seconds. Deals massive Holy Energy damage per second. Demons and Corrupted Veyn users take 2x damage. Cannot be extinguished by normal means.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 45 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Serapharch only

name: God's Index Finger
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Manifests a massive golden finger that can press down on a target to suppress their movement and power. It can also shrink into an extension of the user's own hand for close combat.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Serapharch Active - Divine Judgment

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Single devastating strike. 500% weapon damage as Holy Energy. Doubles against evil-aligned. Ignores shields.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 120 seconds

fields.label: Grade
fields.value: S-Grade

name: God Chain
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Creates strong chains of light that bind a target's body and restrict their ability to move or cast skills.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Serapharch Active — Binding

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Chains of divine light bind the target for up to 10 seconds. The target cannot move, attack, or use Veyn. Chains weaken by 1 second per 10% of angel’s max Veyn spent. Breaking free deals self-damage.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 90 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Serapharch only

name: Holy Grail
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Manifests a sphere of pure holy fire that burns with the heat of a true sun. The user can shrink it down to the size of a pebble for extreme concentrated power, or expand it into a larger form. The bigger it becomes, the more Veyn it costs and the more the heat spreads, though the focused small form is far more destructive against a single target.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Serapharch Active — Ultimate Healing

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Channels the World Core’s energy through a manifested grail. Heals one target to full health, removes all negative status effects, and grants 10 seconds of invulnerability. The angel is incapacitated for 5 seconds after use.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 300 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Serapharch only

name: Warpstep
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Allows the user to instantly relocate to any point within 6 meters by folding space with Veyn.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord Active — Teleportation

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The angel teleports up to 20 meters in any direction, leaving a trail of Holy Energy that damages enemies. Can be used to dodge attacks or reposition instantly.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 8 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: A-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord and above

name: Dawnveil (Serapharch)
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: The highest form of the innate angelic disguise. The user can perfectly hide their wings, halo, aura, and true nature, blending flawlessly into any society. Even strong magical senses struggle to see through it. The disguise costs almost no effort to maintain at this rank.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Active — Barrier

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a dome of golden light that blocks all incoming attacks for 5 seconds. Allies inside can attack through the barrier. The barrier has HP equal to 200% of the angel’s max Veyn.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 60 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Serapharch only

name: Skyward Chains
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: A lesser form of God Chain. Forms lighter chains that still restrain a target but are easier to break with enough force.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord Active — Crowd Control

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Chains erupt from the ground, lifting all enemies within 15 meters into the air for 4 seconds. Lifted enemies cannot act and take Holy Energy damage. Works on targets up to 1 grade below the angel.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 45 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: A-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord and above

name: Vanguard's Cry
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: A powerful battle shout that temporarily strengthens the bodies and resolve of all angels under the user's command.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord Active - Party Buff

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Battle cry inspiring allies within 20m. +25% attack speed, +15% Veyn regen, fear immunity for 20s.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 90 seconds

fields.label: Grade
fields.value: A-Grade+

name: Aegis Ward
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Forms a solid barrier of light and condensed Veyn that can block incoming attacks. Maintaining the barrier continuously drains the user's regenerative ability.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Virtue Active — Shield

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a personal shield that absorbs damage equal to 80% of the angel’s max Veyn. Shield persists for 15 seconds or until broken. When broken, releases a burst of Holy Energy that knocks back nearby enemies.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 30 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Virtue and above

name: Holy Mend
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: A weaker version of Holy Rain. Heals allies and harms undead in a smaller area with reduced potency.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Virtue Active — Healing

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Heals a single target for 60% of the angel’s max Veyn over 6 seconds. Also regenerates 5% of the target’s max HP per second for the duration. Can be cast while moving.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 15 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Virtue and above

name: Angelic Aura (Aetherblade)
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: A powerful but lesser version of the Serapharch's aura. It creates heavy pressure that makes weaker beings hesitate and struggle to fight at full strength. Not as absolute as the highest rank, but still difficult to ignore.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Active — Combat Aura

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Expands the angel’s aura into a 20-meter zone. Allies gain +20% attack power. Enemies within take minor Holy Energy damage per second and have their movement speed reduced by 15%.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 60 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: A-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord only

name: Swiftstep
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: The user folds space in an instant, vanishing from their current position and reappearing up to 3 meters away in a blink. The movement is nearly impossible to track with the naked eye, allowing them to slip behind an opponent, dodge a fatal strike, or close distance before the enemy can react. Though shorter in range than Warpstep, its speed and low Veyn cost make it ideal for rapid, repeated use in close combat.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Virtue Active — Movement

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The angel dashes forward 12 meters, leaving a trail that slows enemies by 20% for 3 seconds. Can be used to dodge attacks. Reset on successful dodge.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 6 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Virtue and above

name: Dawnveil (Aetherblade)
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Allows the user to hide their true form and aura, blending into normal society. The disguise is solid but not perfect — close inspection or strong magical senses can reveal subtle flaws.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Active — Barrier

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a wall of golden light that blocks projectiles and movement for 4 seconds. Allies can pass through. The wall has HP equal to 120% of the angel’s max Veyn.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 40 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: A-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord only

name: Guiding Light
subtitle: Virtue skill
description: A gentle healing touch that closes minor wounds. It has no effect on undead or heavily corrupted beings.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Virtue Active — Support

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Marks an ally with a guiding light. For 10 seconds, the marked ally deals +20% damage and their attacks heal them for 5% of damage dealt. If the marked ally drops below 30% HP, they are teleported to the angel.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 45 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Virtue and above

name: Radiant Strike
subtitle: Virtue skill
description: Infuses the user's weapon with a faint holy charge, causing extra damage to undead and demons on contact.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Virtue Active — Melee Attack

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: A empowered weapon strike that deals 200% weapon damage as Holy Energy. If the target is a demon or corrupted being, damage increases to 300%. Applies a burning effect for 5 seconds.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 12 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Virtue and above

name: Formation Discipline
subtitle: Virtue skill
description: When fighting near other Virtues, the user gains increased strength and defense through coordinated discipline.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Passive — Tactical Bonus

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: When fighting alongside other angels, all participating angels gain +15% to all stats. The more angels in formation, the stronger the bonus (max +45% with 4+ angels).

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: None (passive)

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Virtue and above

name: Angelic Aura (Virtue)
subtitle: Virtue skill
description: A steady passive presence that creates unease in those nearby. It doesn't force submission, but it unsettles opponents and makes them feel watched and pressured.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Active — Minor Aura

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Expands the angel’s aura into a 10-meter zone. Allies gain +10% attack power and minor Veyn regeneration. Enemies within take negligible Holy Energy damage.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 45 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Virtue only

name: Dawnveil (Virtue)
subtitle: Virtue skill
description: A rougher version of the disguise. It works well at a distance, but under stress or close scrutiny it becomes unstable and more likely to slip.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Active — Small Barrier

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a small barrier that blocks projectiles for 3 seconds. The barrier has HP equal to 60% of the angel’s max Veyn.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 30 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Virtue only

name: Warmth of the Realm
subtitle: Lumen skill
description: A gentle passive aura that eases minor pain, calms fear, and softens emotional distress in those nearby. It has no combat use and exists purely as a reflection of a Lumen's role as an ordinary citizen rather than a warrior.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Virtue Passive — Environmental

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The angel’s presence purifies the immediate area. Corrupted Veyn within 5 meters is neutralized. Allies in range regenerate 2% Veyn per second. Cold and environmental hazards are reduced.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: None (passive)

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Virtue and above

name: Faint Ward
subtitle: Lumen skill
description: Creates a thin, fragile shield capable of blocking only a single low-power attack before shattering.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Lumen Active — Basic Shield

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a small personal shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of the angel’s max Veyn. Lasts 8 seconds or until broken.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 20 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: D-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Lumen

name: Angelic Aura (Lumen)
subtitle: Lumen skill
description: The weakest form. It only produces a faint sense of presence, barely noticeable unless someone is paying close attention.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Active — Weak Aura

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: A faint aura that provides minimal Holy Energy protection to allies within 5 meters. +5% Veyn regeneration. Lasts 10 seconds.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 30 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: D-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Lumen only

name: Dawnveil (Lumen)
subtitle: Lumen skill
description: The weakest form of the angelic disguise. It can hide the user's true nature at a glance, but any close inspection or focused magical scrutiny will cause it to break almost immediately.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Active — Weak Barrier

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: A thin barrier that blocks a single projectile. Breaks on impact. 10-second cooldown.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 10 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: D-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Lumen only

name: Demon Skills
subtitle: The skills of demons
description: The abilities demons wield, drawn from their corrupted Veyn and their rank. Each demon rank has its own skills, and the demon generals each carry their own personal techniques. Demon titles also grant their own set of skills, distinct from rank abilities.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Demon-exclusive active and passive skills unlocked through rank progression and the Pact system.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: Drawn from Corrupted Veyn channeled through the demon Pact with the World Core.

fields.label: Progression
fields.value: New skills unlock at each rank: Gnash (basic), Scourge (intermediate), Bloodward (advanced), Mordrach (ultimate).

name: Death Scythe
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Forms a massive scythe from pure Veyn, enchanted with an instant-death attribute. A clean cut from this weapon can end a life in a single stroke if the target is weaker or caught off guard. Its raw destructive power is the true strength of the ability.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Mordrach Ultimate — Melee Attack

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Summons a massive scythe of pure death energy. Deals 600% weapon damage in a wide arc. Enemies killed by this skill are raised as temporary undead minions for 30 seconds.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 120 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Mordrach only

name: Chain Reaper Scythe
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: A long chain scythe controlled entirely by the user's will. It can be compacted into a small accessory when not needed.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Mordrach Active — Ranged Melee

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The scythe extends on a chain of dark energy, striking targets up to 15 meters away. Pulls the target toward the demon. Deals 250% weapon damage. Can hit multiple targets in a line.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 15 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Mordrach only

name: Call of the Dead
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Tears open a temporary gate that releases a group of undead soldiers to fight under the user's command.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Mordrach Active — Summoning

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Raises 5-10 undead minions from nearby corpses. Minions last 60 seconds, attack the demon’s enemies, and explode on death dealing AoE Corrupted Veyn damage.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 90 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Mordrach only

name: Dominating Will
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Floods the surrounding area with the user's Veyn, thickening it until breathing becomes difficult and other people struggle to control their own magic. The denser the user makes it, the higher the Veyn cost.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Mordrach Active — Mind Control

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Asserts dominance over a single target for up to 8 seconds. The target fights for the demon. Control breaks if the demon takes damage. Cannot control targets more than 1 grade above the demon.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 120 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Mordrach only

name: Soul Oath
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Allows the user to form binding contracts with anyone. Once the contract is accepted, the other party's soul is bound until the terms are fulfilled or the user willingly releases them. Breaking the contract brings severe consequences.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Mordrach Active — Binding Contract

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Forces a target to swear a binding oath. If the target breaks the oath, they take massive Corrupted Veyn damage equal to 80% of their max HP. The oath must be specific and verifiable.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 300 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Mordrach only

name: Veyn Decomposition (Mordrach)
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: The strongest form of the innate demon ability. Converts the user's Veyn into a dense, toxic miasma that poisons living beings, weakens holy energy, and contaminates the surrounding area.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Active — Veyn Destruction

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Decomposes a target’s Veyn reserves, reducing their max Veyn by 30% for 20 seconds. The stolen Veyn is added to the demon’s reserves. Cannot reduce below 10% max Veyn.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 45 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Mordrach only

name: Hands of Death
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: A rare high-rank ability. By touching a target, the user can erase a portion of their memories. The erasure is never complete, but it can remove key knowledge, skills, or recent events. Covering the body in stronger Veyn can briefly resist it.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Mordrach Active — Grapple

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Spectral hands erupt from the ground, grabbing all enemies within 10 meters. Targets are held for 5 seconds, taking Corrupted Veyn damage each second. Can be broken by allies destroying the hands.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 60 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Mordrach only

name: Purgatory Flames
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Summons purple flames that cling to a target and continue burning until the user releases them or the target dies. The flames are extremely difficult to extinguish and can only be reliably blocked by a strong Holy Rain.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Mordrach Active — AoE Fire

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Erupts the ground with dark flames in a 15-meter radius. Flames deal Corrupted Veyn damage per second for 8 seconds. Enemies killed in the flames cannot be resurrected.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 60 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Mordrach only

name: Charm
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: A skill exclusive to female demons. It forces a weaker target to obey the user's spoken commands for a limited time. Stronger beings can resist or break free more easily.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Bloodward Active — Mind Influence

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Charms a single target for 5 seconds. The charmed target believes the demon is an ally and will fight for them. Charm breaks on damage. Targets above the demon’s grade resist.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 30 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: A-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Bloodward and above

name: Soul-Sight
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Allows the user to see the flow of a target’s soul, effectively predicting the direction and timing of their next attack. This ability does not work on angels of any rank — angels have no soul. What an angel carries instead is a spiritual body, the holy form bound to their Vow, and Soul-Sight can only perceive souls, so an angel’s spiritual body is invisible to it. Demons can never read an angel’s soul, because there is nothing there to read. Against a hybrid in his sealed form, Soul-Sight breaks in a way no demon can explain: it flickers — half a soul and half a spiritual body held at once, a thing held to be impossible. But when the hybrid takes a single form, the flicker stops. In his full demon form his soul reads as a clean half-demon soul, and in his full angel form as a clean half-spiritual-body; only in the sealed form, where both halves coexist, does the sight stutter on and off. Even that single-form reading is a riddle, though: the soul is only half, and any demon who sees it must ask why a demon’s soul is incomplete — a question with no good answer.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Bloodward Active — Detection

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The demon perceives the soul of any being within 50 meters — unless that being is an angel, who has a spiritual body instead of a soul, and so cannot be read. A hybrid flickers only in his sealed form (both halves at once); in full demon form he reads as a clean half-demon soul, in full angel form as a clean half-spiritual-body.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 20 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: A-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Bloodward and above

name: Berserk (Mordrach)
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Triggers automatically when the user's health drops critically low. Attack power and magic surge to extreme levels (roughly 20 times normal), but reasoning and self-control are sharply reduced, making the user far more reckless.

fields.label: Type

name: Dark Moon
subtitle: Hidden and Dangerous group of people
description:
Dark Moon is a covert organization founded and led by Wener Leger, a Fallen Angel who was cast out of the Angel Realm for breaking his Vow. It is not a revolution, not a resistance, and not a rebellion — it is a instrument of domination, built with the patience of someone who has spent centuries learning exactly how power works and exactly how to take it.

Dark Moon's goal is total control of the Realms — not to liberate the oppressed, not to reform the broken systems, but to replace every ruler with someone who answers to Wener Leger. The organization operates in the shadows, recruiting the discarded, the disgraced, and the desperate, turning their grievances into weapons and their ambition into fuel. Every member believes they are working toward their own liberation. None of them realize they are building a cage.

---

## ORGANIZATION STRUCTURE

Dark Moon is organized in concentric circles, each layer knowing only what it needs to:

### The Inner Circle (3 members)
Only three people know the full scope of Dark Moon's plan. They meet in person once a year, in a location that changes each time. Communication between meetings is conducted through encrypted Ren-signals — messages encoded in the flow of Ren energy, undetectable by Veyn-based surveillance.

• **Wener Leger (The Architect)** — Leader. Former Aetherblade Lord Angel, now Fallen Angel. A Grade, Mid stage. Bladesinger class. He hides behind a swordsmanship teacher's post at Elyndor Academy, using the Academy's neutrality as cover. He is patient, methodical, and ruthless — not cruel for cruelty's sake, but willing to do whatever is necessary to achieve his goal. He does not enjoy hurting people, but he does not lose sleep over it either. He sees the world as a machine with broken parts, and he intends to rebuild it with himself as the operator.

• **Licent Varak (The Insider)** — Second right-hand man to Tera Morage, the Mordrach of the Demon Realm. Bloodward rank, Dregs race. He joined Dark Moon not out of ideology but out of raw ambition: he wants to kill Tera Morage and seize the Mordrach's throne. Wener offered him the resources and intelligence to do it; Licent offered Dark Moon a seat at the most powerful table in the Demon Realm. Their relationship is transactional — Wener uses Licent's position to spy on and destabilize the Demon Realm, while Licent uses Wener's network to build his own power base. Neither trusts the other. Both know the arrangement is temporary.

• **Sevra Ashveil (The Financier)** — A former human Broker who was stripped of her certification after she was caught laundering money for a demon trade network. She now manages Dark Moon's finances: front companies, hidden accounts, trade routes that move supplies, weapons, and intelligence across realm borders. She is quiet, precise, and invisible — the kind of person who can move a fortune without anyone noticing. She does not care about domination or liberation; she cares about balance sheets. Dark Moon pays well, and she is very good at her job.

### The Outer Circle (12–15 members)
The operatives who carry out Dark Moon's missions. Each was recruited individually by Wener or by a trusted inner-circle member. They know Dark Moon exists, they know Wener is the leader, and they know the goal is "change." They do not know the full plan. They are given specific tasks — gather intelligence, sabotage a ward, transport a package, eliminate a target — and they complete them. Most believe they are part of a liberation movement. Some suspect they are not. None of them leave.

Key operatives include:

• **Drenick Voss** — A Fallen Angel who was cast out for refusing to fight in the Angel Civil War. He is Wener's most trusted field agent, the one who handles the jobs that require precision and discretion. He is not a fighter — he is a spy, a saboteur, and a poisoner. He has no aura (it faded when he fell), which makes him invisible to Veyn-based detection. He has infiltrated the Angel Realm's border patrols three times without being caught.

• **Mara Kesh** — A Scourge-rank demon who was banished from the Demon Realm for challenging a Bloodward general and losing. She is the muscle of the Outer Circle — the person Wener sends when a target needs to be killed quietly. She fights with raw demonic strength, no class skills, no Veyn techniques, just violence. She is loyal to Wener because Wener gave her purpose after her banishment. She does not ask questions.

• **Fen Halloway** — A human information broker who was ruined by the Broker's Guild after he sold classified intelligence to a demon trade network. He now runs Dark Moon's intelligence network — a web of informants, bribed officials, and intercepted communications across all three realms. He knows more about the world's secrets than anyone alive, and he sells that knowledge to whoever pays. Dark Moon pays the most.

• **Ashara Dune** — A Pallantine elf who was exiled from the Arubian Forest for practicing forbidden Veyn techniques — specifically, attempts to communicate with the Shudon. She is Dark Moon's researcher, the one who studies Aelthar artifacts, translates ancient texts, and experiments with Veyn manipulation. She believes Dark Moon is a scholarly organization dedicated to recovering lost knowledge. She is wrong.

### The Shadow Network (50–100 people)
The outermost layer: informants, sympathizers, and unwitting assets who provide Dark Moon with services — safe houses, forged documents, transportation, alibis. Most of them do not know they are working for Dark Moon. They know they are helping a "concerned citizen" or a "trade association" or a "scholarly society." Dark Moon's fronts are carefully constructed to look like ordinary organizations. The Safe Harbor Alliance (a humanitarian group), the Midnight Archive (a historical preservation society), and the Open Road Collective (a trade guild) are all Dark Moon fronts.

---

## THE PLAN (Seven Stages)

Wener Leger's plan to seize control of the Realms is not a single dramatic coup. It is a seven-stage process designed to weaken every existing power structure simultaneously, then fill the vacuum with Dark Moon's people. The plan has been in motion for over a century.

**Stage 1: Infiltrate (Complete)**
Dark Moon agents have infiltrated key positions across all three realms: border patrols, trade guilds, military commands, and the Broker's Guild. Licent Varak's position as Tera Morage's second right-hand is the crown jewel — it gives Dark Moon direct access to the Demon Realm's military intelligence.

**Stage 2: Destabilize (In Progress)**
Dark Moon has been quietly destabilizing cross-realm relations: planting evidence of angel-demon border violations, intercepting diplomatic communications, and sabotaging trade agreements. The goal is to make every realm distrust every other realm, reducing the likelihood of alliances when the turning arrives.

**Stage 3: Acquire the Hybrid (In Progress)**
Wener's primary objective regarding Jaiden Marlock is not to kill him but to control him. Dark Moon has spent years positioning Wener as Jaiden's mentor and trusted advisor. The goal is to be the voice in Jaiden's ear when the turning arrives — to influence his choice toward a "seam" that Dark Moon controls. If control is not possible, the secondary objective is to capture Jaiden and extract his hybrid Veyn for use in Dark Moon's own rituals.

**Stage 4: Seize the Altar (Planned)**
The Academy Sundering Altar is the most powerful Veyn amplifier in the world. Dark Moon plans to seize it during the turning, using the chaos as cover. With the Altar under their control, they can amplify Jaiden's Veyn (if they capture him) or conduct their own mass-awakening ritual (if they don't). Either outcome strengthens Dark Moon's position.

**Stage 5: Control the Turning (Planned)**
During the Fourth Turning, Dark Moon intends to manipulate events so that the outcome benefits them. If Jaiden chooses the seam, Dark Moon stitches it. If Jaiden chooses the silence, Dark Moon fills the void. If Jaiden refuses to choose, Dark Moon forces the issue. Every contingency has been planned.

**Stage 6: Replace the Rulers (Post-Turning)**
After the turning, the existing power structures will be weakened — damaged by the World Eater's surge, the Abyssal Wyrm's breach, and the Void Colossus's appearance. Dark Moon will position its agents as the new authorities: Licent Varak as Mordrach (if Tera falls), a puppet Serapharch (if Clint falls), and a human ruler loyal to Dark Moon (if Ruby falls).

**Stage 7: Consolidate (Endgame)**
With puppet rulers in place and the turning resolved on Dark Moon's terms, Wener Leger steps out of the shadows and takes the throne — not as a visible tyrant, but as the invisible hand behind every ruler. The world will not know it has been conquered. It will believe it has been saved.

---

## RECRUITMENT

Dark Moon recruits through three primary methods:

**1. Exploiting Grievances**
Every member of Dark Moon has been wronged by the existing order. Fallen angels were cast out for breaking Vows. Banished demons were exiled for losing power struggles. Ruined humans were destroyed by institutions that were supposed to protect them. Wener does not create grievances — he finds them. He identifies people who have been chewed up by the world's systems and offers them something no one else will: acknowledgment. "You were not wrong. The system was wrong. And I can prove it."

This is Dark Moon's most effective recruitment tool, and it is effective because it is partly true. The world's systems ARE broken. The Vow system IS unforgiving. The Demon Realm IS brutal. The Broker's Guild IS corrupt. Wener tells people the truth — and then, once they trust him, he bends that truth toward his own purposes.

**2. Trading Favors**
Dark Moon operates on a debt economy. Wener does not ask people to join; he helps them first, then calls in the favor. He provides safe houses for fleeing exiles, intelligence for people seeking revenge, and resources for those who have nothing. By the time he asks for something in return, the person owes him everything. Most of them do not realize the favor was engineered — that Wener created the problem he solved.

**3. Blackmail and Leverage**
For the Outer Circle and the Shadow Network, Dark Moon sometimes uses coercion. Fen Halloway's intelligence network identifies people with secrets — affairs, debts, crimes, loyalties they should not have. Dark Moon leverages those secrets to ensure compliance. This is Wener's least preferred method (it creates resentment and increases the risk of exposure) but he uses it when necessary.

---

## RELATIONSHIP WITH LICENT VARAK

The relationship between Wener Leger and Licent Varak is the most volatile element in Dark Moon's structure — and the one Wener understands best.

**How They Met**
Wener identified Licent as a potential asset over a decade ago, when Licent was still a Scourge-rank demon climbing the ranks of the Demon Army. Licent's hatred of Lisa was well-known — he was constantly scheming against her, constantly looking for leverage. Wener approached him through a Dark Moon intermediary (Fen Halloway, operating under a false identity) and offered him information: the location of a secret meeting between Lisa and Ordium. Licent used that information to report Lisa to Tera Morage, which led to Lisa's demotion and eventual death.

Licent did not know he was being manipulated. He believed he discovered the affair on his own. Wener let him believe it. The truth — that Wener had been watching Lisa for years, that he knew about the hybrid child, and that he sacrificed Lisa's life to gain a foothold in the Demon Realm — is known only to Wener and Sevra Ashveil.

**The Bargain**
After Lisa's death, Wener approached Licent directly. He revealed Dark Moon's existence and offered Licent a deal: Dark Moon would help Licent rise to the Mordrach's throne. In return, Licent would give Dark Moon control of the Demon Realm's military once he was in power. Licent agreed — not because he trusted Wener, but because he needed resources he could not acquire alone.

The bargain is written in a Demon Pact, signed by both parties. The Pact is enforceable: if Licent breaks it, his Veyn reserves drain. If Wener breaks it, his already-damaged halo shatters completely. Neither can afford to break the Pact. Neither can afford to honor it fully. This is by design — Wener chose a Pact (a binding contract of mutual self-interest) precisely because it creates a stalemate that keeps both parties invested.

**The Truth Licent Does Not Know**
Wener's plan for Licent is simple: use him to destabilize the Demon Realm, then discard him. Licent is not meant to become Mordrach — he is meant to weaken Tera Morage enough that someone else can kill her. Wener has already identified Tera's replacement: a Scourge-rank demon named Vaelith, who was banished years ago and now operates in the Human Realm as a black-market weapons dealer. Vaelith is stronger than Licent, smarter than Licent, and loyal to Dark Moon because Dark Moon saved her life.

Licent believes he is the beneficiary of the arrangement. He is the instrument.

**Licent's Death**
The Fourth Turning disrupts Wener's plan for Licent. During the turning, Licent attempts to kill Tera Morage while she is weakened by the Abyssal Wyrm's null-breath — an action Wener did not authorize. Licent acts on his own ambition, rushing to seize the throne before the turning resolves. Tera, weakened but not broken, kills him with her bare hands.

Wener receives the news and feels nothing. Licent was a tool that broke. He immediately activates the contingency: Vaelith, who has been waiting in the shadows for years, steps forward to fill the power vacuum in the Demon Realm. Wener's plan survives Licent's death — barely — but the disruption costs Dark Moon valuable time and resources.

**What Licent Meant to Dark Moon**
Beyond the political value, Licent served a psychological purpose for Wener: he was proof that the world's systems produce their own destruction. Licent was created by the Demon Realm's brutal meritocracy — a system that rewards ambition and punishes weakness. Wener did not corrupt Licent; the Demon Realm did. Wener simply gave Licent a direction for the rage the realm manufactured.

This is Wener's core belief about recruitment: he does not create villains. The world creates them. He just gives them a banner.

---

## DARK MOON'S CULTURE

**No Ideology**
Dark Moon has no manifesto, no creed, no founding philosophy. Wener explicitly forbids the creation of one. "Ideologies are prisons," he tells his inner circle. "People die for ideas. I want them to live for me." This makes Dark Moon uniquely dangerous — it cannot be defeated by disproving its beliefs, because it has none.

**Meritocracy of Usefulness**
Dark Moon values competence above all else. Members are promoted based on results, not loyalty, race, or rank. A human information broker can outrank a Fallen Angel if the broker produces better intelligence. This creates a meritocracy that appeals to people who were rejected by their home realms — people who were told they were not enough.

**The Moon Brand**
All Inner Circle and Outer Circle members carry a brand: a crescent moon on the inside of the left wrist, burned in with Ren energy. It is invisible to Veyn-based detection (Ren energy does not register on Veyn scanners) but visible to anyone who knows to look. The brand serves two purposes: identification (Dark Moon members can recognize each other) and commitment (the brand is painful to remove and leaves a scar). Wener calls it "a promise without a Vow." The irony is intentional.

**The Code**
Dark Moon operates under three rules:
1. Never reveal Dark Moon to an outsider. (Punishment: death.)
2. Never act against Dark Moon's interests. (Punishment: exile — which, for most members, is worse than death.)
3. Never lie to the Architect. (Punishment: the truth is used against you.)

---

## DARK MOON'S WEAKNESSES

**1. Wener Is the Linchpin**
Dark Moon is entirely dependent on Wener Leger. If he dies, the organization fractures within weeks. The Inner Circle members do not trust each other. The Outer Circle members do not know each other. The Shadow Network does not know it is part of Dark Moon. Without Wener holding it together, Dark Moon dissolves into a collection of disgruntled exiles with grudges and no direction.

**2. Licent's Impulsiveness**
Licent Varak is the weakest link. His ambition makes him useful but unpredictable. He acts without authorization, pursues personal vendettas, and draws attention to Dark Moon's operations. Wener has considered removing him multiple times but keeps him because the cost of replacing him (finding another Bloodward demon with access to Tera Morage) is too high.

**3. No Popular Support**
Dark Moon has no base of support among ordinary people. It operates in the shadows, recruits from the margins, and alienates anyone who might sympathize with its methods. It is a conspiracy, not a movement. If exposed, it would be destroyed — not because the world's armies are strong enough, but because no one would defend it.

**4. Jaiden Is Uncontrollable**
Wener's plan assumes he can control Jaiden Marlock. This assumption is wrong. Jaiden is stubborn, compassionate, and self-doubting — qualities that make him vulnerable to manipulation but also impossible to predict. Wener can influence Jaiden, but he cannot control him. The Fourth Turning will prove this.

---

## STORY RELEVANCE

Dark Moon is the antagonist organization of the Half-Made World narrative. It is not the primary antagonist (that role belongs to the World Eater and the cosmic forces of the turning) but it is the most personal antagonist — the one that operates through trust, manipulation, and the exploitation of broken people. Dark Moon's tragedy is that every member was genuinely wronged by the world's systems. Wener's evil is not that he lies — it is that he tells the truth and uses it as a weapon.

The Fourth Turning exposes Dark Moon's weaknesses. Licent's impulsiveness disrupts the plan. Jaiden's uncontrollability defies the strategy. The World Eater's surge forces Dark Moon to choose between its plan and its survival. In the aftermath, Dark Moon is fractured — Wener retreats into the shadows, the Inner Circle scatters, and the Outer Circle dissolves. But Wener is patient, and the world's systems are still broken. Dark Moon will return.
