name: Jaiden Marlock Plot
subtitle: Plot for Mc
description: The central storyline following Jaiden Marlock from sealed hybrid boy to the bridge between realms. Three-act structure spanning the full14-book arc.

fields.label: Act 1 — The Sealed Boy (Books 1-3)
fields.value: Jaiden arrives at Elyndor Academy at age 14, disguised as a normal human. The Auralis Ruby suppresses his hybrid nature. He meets Bella Rose (first real friend), Mark Wesley (loyal companion), and Sofia Marlock (adoptive sister/mentor). First Veyn Storm at the Academy forces his sealed power to leak — Clint Ashborn notices. Wener Leger begins positioning himself as Jaiden mentor. The Ruby first seal cracks during a training spar, revealing a faint halo and horns for the first time.

fields.label: Act 2 — The Unraveling (Books 4-9)
fields.value: Jaiden discovers his hybrid nature and the Prophecy of the Half-Made. Kael von Ashen becomes his secret tutor. The Sealed Writings begin calling to him. Dark Moon escalates — Licent Varak reports to Tera Morage about the hybrid. Ruby Divina sees Jaiden as a political asset. The Academy tournament arc: Jaiden forced to reveal Halo & Horns form publicly. Clint attempts to recruit him; Wener tries to manipulate him. Jaiden struggles with dual-channel Veyn — mastering both angelic and demonic skills simultaneously. Third seal breaks during the Demon Realm crisis.

fields.label: Act 3 — The Fourth Turning (Books 10-14)
fields.value: The Fourth Turning approaches. World Eater surges. Abyssal Wyrm seal cracks. Dark Moon launches full assault on the Academy. Jaiden must choose between three offers: Clint seam (angelic control), Wener seam (Dark Moon chaos), or the Eater silence (end everything). He rejects all three, chooses to become the bridge. Auralis Ruby shatters. Hybrid Veyn floods the World Barrier. Barriers soften into permeable membranes. Shudon reactivate. World Eater pushed back. Jaiden sacrifices his hybrid nature — wings, horns, halo gone. He becomes ordinary. The world is forever changed.

fields.label: Central Conflict
fields.value: Identity — Who am I? Belonging — Where do I fit? Power — Can I control both natures? Legacy — Am I the savior or the destroyer? The prophecy says he must choose "the seam or the silence" — but he finds a third option.

fields.label: Character Arc
fields.value: Sealed boy → Curious student → Reluctant hero → Chosen one → Sacrificer → Ordinary person who changed the world. His greatest growth is accepting that his difference is a gift, not a curse.

fields.label: Key Turning Points
fields.value: 1) First seal crack at Academy spar (Book 2). 2) Public reveal at tournament (Book 5). 3) Third seal breaks in Demon Realm (Book 8). 4) Auralis Ruby shatters at Fourth Turning (Book 12). 5) Sacrifices hybrid nature (Book 14).

fields.label: Story Relevance
fields.value: The narrative engine — every faction agenda revolves around Jaiden. His choices determine whether the world is mended or destroyed.

fields.label: Lore Connections
fields.value: Prophecy of the Half-Made, Auralis Ruby, Sealed Writings, Fourth Turning, World Eater, Shudon, all five Character Forms, Hybrid Fusion.

name: Ruby Divina’s Plot
subtitle: The mortal ruler’s gambit
description: Ruby Divina — the Human Realm ruler, a political mastermind who sees Jaiden as the key to humanity’s supremacy. Her arc moves from ally to antagonist to reluctant partner.

fields.label: The Political Game
fields.value: Ruby rules the Human Realm through intelligence networks and Broker connections. She learned of the hybrid Jaiden through her spy network and has been watching him since birth. She does not care about the prophecy — she cares about leverage. A hybrid means humanity can negotiate with both angels and demons from a position of strength.

fields.label: Her Offer (Book 4)
fields.value: Ruby approaches Jaiden at the Academy with a deal: she will protect him from both angel and demon hunters if he pledges fealty to the Human Realm. She offers resources, training, and political cover. The price: he must act as humanity’s ambassador to the other realms. Jaiden refuses — he will not be a pawn. This puts them at odds.

fields.label: Escalation (Books 7-10)
fields.value: As the Fourth Turning approaches, Ruby grows desperate. She attempts to capture Jaiden to force his cooperation. Her agents clash with both Dark Moon and Angel forces. She discovers the Sealed Writings contain information about the World Barrier that could give humanity control over realm travel. She wants it.

fields.label: Redemption Arc (Books 11-14)
fields.value: When the World Eater surges and the Abyssal Wyrm breaks free, Ruby realizes her political games are meaningless against existential threats. She joins the alliance against the Eater. She provides the human army, the Broker network, and the intelligence that helps locate the Weak Points. She does not apologize — but she acts.

fields.label: Story Relevance
fields.value: Ruby represents the political dimension of the conflict. While Jaiden fights for personal identity, Ruby fights for power. Their clash is ideological: compassion vs. pragmatism.

name: Clint Ashborn’s Plot
subtitle: The immaculate tyrant
description: Clint Ashborn — the Serapharch who executed Ordium and now hunts the hybrid. His arc is one of guilt, duty, and the cost of blind obedience.

fields.label: The Execution (Flashback)
fields.value: Clint personally executed Ordium on orders from the Angel hierarchy. He believed he was doing justice — a demon who seduced an angel and created an abomination. But the execution haunted him. He saw Ordium’s face in his dreams for years. When he discovered Jaiden exists, the guilt intensified.

fields.label: The Hunt (Books 1-6)
fields.value: Clint initially hunts Jaiden to eliminate the hybrid threat. He sends the Six Pillars to the Academy. But as he observes Jaiden — his kindness, his struggle, his humanity — Clint begins to doubt. He sees Lisa in Jaiden’s eyes. He sees Ordium’s defiance. He begins to question whether the Angel hierarchy was wrong.

fields.label: The Crisis (Books 7-10)
fields.value: Clint discovers the Prophecy of the Half-Made was deliberately hidden by the Angel hierarchy. They knew about the Fourth Turning and chose to suppress the prophecy rather than prepare for it. Clint realizes the hierarchy is not protecting the world — they are protecting their power. He begins working against them from within.

fields.label: Alliance (Books 11-14)
fields.value: Clint sends the Six Pillars to help defend the Academy during the Fourth Turning. He publicly breaks with the Angel hierarchy, declaring that the half-breed is the only hope. This causes a schism in the angel ranks — some follow him, others remain loyal to the hierarchy. He fights alongside Jaiden at the final battle.

fields.label: Story Relevance
fields.value: Clint is the mirror of Jaiden — an angel who killed a demon and now must protect the hybrid child of both. His arc asks: can duty and compassion coexist? The answer shapes the angels’ role in the final battle.

name: Wener Leger’s Plot
subtitle: The patient tyrant
description: Wener Leger — the Fallen Angel who leads Dark Moon. His arc is one of ambition, manipulation, and the collapse of a master plan.

fields.label: The Fall (Flashback)
fields.value: Wener fell not through weakness or doubt, but through deliberate ambition. He was a Virtue-rank angel who believed the hierarchy was corrupt and stagnant. He broke his Vow intentionally — not through betrayal of a specific person, but through a cold rejection of the system itself. He fell cleanly: black-spotted wings, broken halo, full sanity. He founded Dark Moon within a decade.

fields.label: The Seven-Stage Plan (Books 1-10)
fields.value: Wener has been executing a 7-stage plan for years: infiltrate all realms, destabilize cross-realm relations, acquire the hybrid, seize the Academy Altar, control the Fourth Turning, replace rulers with puppets, and consolidate invisible power. He is the most patient and dangerous antagonist because he does not want to destroy the world — he wants to own it.

fields.label: The Licent Betrayal (Book 8)
fields.value: Wener engineered Licent Varak’s rise to power by feeding him intelligence about Lisa’s affair. Licent used it to report Lisa to Tera. Licent does not know Wener orchestrated it. When Licent tries to act independently during the Fourth Turning and gets killed by Tera, Wener feels nothing — the tool broke, the plan adapts.

fields.label: The Final Gambit (Books 11-14)
fields.value: Wener offers Jaiden the third option: a seam controlled by Dark Moon. He promises to use the hybrid Veyn to reshape the world barrier under his control. Jaiden rejects him. Wener attacks the Academy during the Fourth Turning with his full forces. He is defeated by the combined angel-demon-human alliance. His final words: "You think you won? The world is still broken. You just chose which broken version to live in."

fields.label: Story Relevance
fields.value: Wener is the ideological antagonist — he believes the world is fundamentally broken and only radical change can fix it. His plan is logical, his methods are cruel, and his vision is compelling. He forces Jaiden to articulate why the current world is worth saving.

name: Tera Morage’s Plot
subtitle: The tyrant whose one mercy was a death sentence
description: Tera Morage — the Mordrach demon ruler, a warlord who united the 60 Clans. Her arc is one of power, betrayal, and the cost of ruling through fear.

fields.label: The Unification Wars (Flashback)
fields.value: Tera rose to power through 15 years of brutal warfare, uniting 60 Demon Clans into 20 under her iron fist. She killed or imprisoned every rival. Her method: absolute strength, absolute loyalty, absolute fear. She built the Obsidian Spires as a monument to demon unity — and a warning to defiers.

fields.label: The Licent Problem (Books 1-8)
fields.value: Tera’s second-in-command, Licent Varak, is secretly working with Dark Moon. She suspects but cannot prove it. She keeps him close to monitor him. When Licent reports about the hybrid Jaiden, Tera sees opportunity — a weapon against the angels. She sends agents to the Academy to observe, not capture.

fields.label: The Fourth Turning (Books 10-12)
fields.value: Tera mobilizes the full demon army for the Fourth Turning. She fights the Abyssal Wyrm personally — and wins, but is severely weakened. Licent Varak attempts to seize power during her weakness. Tera kills him with her bare hands. The act costs her — Licent was the closest thing she had to a trusted ally.

fields.label: Alliance (Books 13-14)
fields.value: Weakened but still formidable, Tera joins the final alliance against the World Eater. She provides the demon army and the knowledge of corrupted Veyn that helps Jaiden understand his demonic side. She does not trust the angels — but she trusts the enemy of her enemy. Her final act: personally sealing the Abyssal Wyrm using her own Veyn.

fields.label: Story Relevance
fields.value: Tera represents the demon perspective — power through strength, loyalty through fear. Her arc asks: can a ruler built on fear learn to lead through trust? Her alliance with Jaiden at the end suggests yes, but at great personal cost.

name: Wener Leger
subtitle: Leader of Dark Moon
description: Wener Leger was cast out of the Angel Realm, and Dark Moon is what he built from the wreckage of that fall — not a refuge, but a blade pointed back at everything that discarded him. Its goal is exactly what it sounds like: domination of the Realms, with Wener at the top, and he is patient enough to hide behind a swordsmanship teacher’s post at Elyndor Academy while he pieces the world’s next tyrant together from its own cast-offs. He recruits the desperate and the disgraced — fallen angels, banished demons, and now Licent Varak’s raw ambition — not to free them, but to use them, because the broken are the cheapest soldiers and the easiest to convince they are owed something. He is watching Jaiden Marlock, the first hybrid, the way a collector watches a rare weapon he has not yet decided how to wield. There is no higher cause beneath Dark Moon’s banner and no hidden mercy in its leader; Wener does not want to save the world from its lies. He wants to own it, and he has spent his long exile learning exactly how.

name: An Angel Breaking the vow
subtitle: What happens when an angel’s vow shatters
description: The vow breaks when an angel betrays their own promise — when they do the one thing they swore to themselves they would never do. It is not a punishment handed down by a superior, but the consequence of their own broken word: the promise that held their Veyn steady lets go, and the halo can no longer hold the channel. It shatters, becoming the broken halo Fallen Angels are known for. The uncontrolled Veyn surging through them at that moment leaves permanent black spotting on the feathers — plain black spots or black cherry spotting, depending on how much Veyn surged through when the promise broke.

fields.label: Trigger

fields.label: Result

name: Laren Vornath
subtitle: Demon general of the Demon army
description: A general who fights with misdirection, never taken seriously until the feint lands. Tolerated because he wins, and his cruelty is a performance — but the performance is the point, and he has never once shown fear, which is why no one trusts him. Tera Morage keeps him for his usefulness but does not trust him.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: Six horns and six dark purple feathery wings. His horns are jagged and sharp, his wings scarred from battle but carried with a casual, almost dismissive ease. He wears a grin that never quite reaches his eyes.

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Bloodward

name: Sythra Kaelis
subtitle: Demon general of the Demon army
description: Her cruelty wears the face of mercy. She kills not in anger but in pity — she tells her victims she is relieving them of their sadness as her miasma drains the will and Veyn from them, leaving behind empty, obedient shells. The grief she carries is real, but it is a grief she now administers to others. She was the one sent to “comfort” Lisa after her demotion to Gnash, draining what remained of her before Licent Varak’s men finished it.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: Six horns and six dark purple feathery wings. Her horns are sharp and well-kept, her wings immaculate despite their battle scars. She has the composed, sorrowful bearing of someone who genuinely grieves and kills with that grief in her eyes.

fields.label: Rank

name: Nyra Thessan
subtitle: Demon general of the Demon army
description: She devours magic the way others eat bread. The more she consumes, the stronger she grows, and no battlefield has ever been enough to fill her. She fights not for the realm but because stopping means feeling the hunger again.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: Six horns and six dark purple feathery wings. Her frame is slightly gaunt, her eyes sharp and restless, and she carries herself like someone who is always hungry, which in her case is literal.

fields.label: Rank

name: Isella Marrek
subtitle: Demon general of the Demon army
description: A general who has never once loved anyone back. She treats love as a resource — the devotion and affection of others is something she harvests and hoards to fuel her power. The more people love her, the stronger she grows, so she cultivates followers endlessly, and it is entirely transactional on her end. She recruits and binds the Demon army’s soldiers, which is why their ranks hold together even when the cause is lost, keeping her in Tera Morage’s orbit.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: Six horns and six dark purple feathery wings. She has a striking, magnetic beauty that she wields like a weapon, warm eyes, an inviting smile, and the practiced grace of someone who has learned exactly how to make others love her.

fields.label: Rank

name: Cyrion
subtitle: Angel general of the Angel army
description: The Second Pillar. He watches the far edge of the Angel Realm, where the host does not march. He saw Ordium slip away the first time and said nothing — and he has kept the secret of Jaiden’s parentage ever since, not out of loyalty, but because he doesn’t report what he hasn’t decided to act on.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: Six pure white feathery wings that glow with a steady light, bearing the battle-scars of an Aetherblade Lord. His halo is bright but composed, and his features are calm and watchful.

subtitle: Angel general of the Angel army
description: The Third Pillar — the bulwark who never retreats, and no one has ever thanked her for it. When Ordium abandoned his post, she was next in line for his seat, and she resents that he threw away a rank she would have bled to hold.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: Six pure white feathery wings that glow with a steady light, scarred from years of frontline combat. Her halo burns with a fierce, unwavering brightness, and she has the hard-set jaw and squared shoulders of someone who has never once retreated.

fields.label: Rank

name: Liora Veyne
subtitle: Angel general of the Angel army
description: The Fourth Pillar. She carries the bad news, and she is never wrong. It was Liora who brought the execution order to Ordium’s door, in the same soft voice she uses to announce a dawn. The soldiers say the dread before a battle is her, arriving first.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: Six pure white feathery wings that glow with a steady light. Her halo carries a cold, pale luminescence, and her features are severe and precise.

name: Thalor Elwin
subtitle: The Fifth Pillar — Guardian of the Sundering Altar
description: The Fifth Pillar, and the Guardian of the Sundering Altar — the angel who officiates the Veyn Vow and helps every young angel form their halo. When an angel turns fifteen, it is Thalor who appears at the altar to speak the vow with them, though to most angels he is a rare and half-remembered figure, glimpsed once on the day of their awakening and never again. He keeps the altar and records every vow spoken there, watching for the first sign that a promise is fraying. He saw the signs in Ordium long before he left: a vow pulled thin by something it was never meant to contain. He said nothing then, and has spent every day since wondering whether a single word from him could have stopped all of it.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: Six pure white feathery wings that glow with a steady light, bearing the marks of countless vow ceremonies. His halo has the warm, measured brightness of someone who has spent a lifetime watching promises form and break.

name: Aranweis
subtitle: Angel general of the Angel army
description: The Sixth Pillar — the personal guard of the Serapharch, the first-rank ruler of the Angel Realm. Aranweis is the king’s own watcher, standing always within reach of the throne, his hundred-eyed gaze missing nothing. He has seen every supplicant, every messenger, and every traitor who ever came before the king, and he forgets none of them.

fields.label: Appearance

name: Red Whisper
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: A quiet, Veyn-laced whisper that can interrupt and shatter an enemy's spell while it is being cast.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Bloodward Active — Seduction

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Whispers a target into a state of desire and compliance for 6 seconds. The target’s attacks deal 50% less damage and they cannot target the demon. Breaks on damage to the target.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 30 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Bloodward and above

name: Blood Jape
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Creates a moving double formed from blood and Veyn. The double can take a fatal hit in the user's place before collapsing.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Bloodward Active — Blood Manipulation

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Manipulates a target’s blood, causing them to take damage equal to 15% of their current HP. The damage bypasses shields. Also causes bleeding for 5 seconds.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 30 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Bloodward and above

name: Traitor’s Step
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: After wounding an enemy, the user can instantly exchange positions with them. In the blink of an eye, the injured target is left standing where the user just was, while the user appears in the enemy’s former place — often behind them or in a far more advantageous position. The sudden swap creates perfect openings for follow-up attacks.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Scourge Active — Betrayal Strike

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The demon teleports behind a target and strikes them in the back. Deals 250% weapon damage. If the target is fighting alongside allies (not alone), damage increases to 350%.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 20 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Scourge and above

name: Grey Miasma
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Releases a thin grey mist that clings to the area and slows the movements of anyone who breathes it in.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Bloodward Active — Poison Cloud

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a cloud of toxic miasma in a 10-meter radius. Enemies within take poison damage (5% max HP per second) and have their vision obscured for 8 seconds.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 45 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Bloodward and above

name: Widow’s Toll
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Releases a single deep, resonant note that echoes in the bones of those who hear it. The sound forces the affected to begin crying and strips away their will to fight, making them more obedient to the user for a short time.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Bloodward Active — Life Drain

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Drains the life force of a target, healing the demon for 50% of the damage dealt. Deals 200% weapon damage as Corrupted Veyn. If the target dies, the demon is healed to full.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 30 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Bloodward and above

name: Fading Wound
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Wounds inflicted by the user do not only cause pain — they steadily drain the target's Veyn over time.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Scourge Active — Delayed Damage

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Inflicts a wound that deals no immediate damage but detonates after 5 seconds, dealing all accumulated damage at once. The wound cannot be healed until detonation.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 25 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Scourge and above

name: Heart-Bind
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Creates a Veyn-based bond with a target that prevents them from killing the user. Any damage dealt to the user is partially transferred back onto the one who is bound.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Bloodward Active — Emotional Manipulation

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Binds a target’s emotions, making them feel intense loyalty toward the demon for 8 seconds. The target will not attack the demon or allies. Breaks on strong emotional shock.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 60 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Bloodward and above

name: Lover’s Step
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Subtly influences a target's emotions, making them more willing to listen, trust, or obey the user for a limited time.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Bloodward Active — Teleport to Ally

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Instantly teleports to a charmed or allied target within 30 meters. If teleporting to a charmed target, the demon gains +20% damage for 5 seconds after arrival.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 15 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Bloodward and above

name: Bond-Sight
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Allows the user to see the emotional and magical bonds connecting people. Strong bonds appear as clear threads of light or darkness. The user can read the nature of the bond (loyalty, love, hatred, contract, etc.) and, with enough focus, temporarily weaken or disrupt a bond, creating hesitation or conflict in the target.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Bloodward Active — Bond Detection

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Perceives all emotional and contractual bonds of a target within 30 meters. Reveals allies, enemies, secret alliances, hidden loyalties, and active contracts. Cannot be blocked.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 30 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Bloodward and above

name: Siphon
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Drains magical energy from targets weaker than the user and adds a portion of it to the user's own reserves.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Bloodward Active — Veyn Drain

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Channels a beam that siphons Veyn from a target. Drains 15% of target’s max Veyn per second for 4 seconds. The demon gains the drained Veyn. Cannot be interrupted if the demon stands still.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 30 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: A-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Bloodward and above

name: Unslaked
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: The more magical energy the user absorbs, the stronger their body and attacks temporarily become.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Mordrach Passive — Hunger

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The demon’s hunger is never satisfied. Killing a target restores 20% of max HP and 10% of max Veyn. Each kill within 10 seconds of the last stacks an additional +5% damage (max 5 stacks).

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: None (passive)

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Mordrach only

name: Seal
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Temporarily locks away one of an opponent's special abilities, preventing its use for a short period.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Mordrach Active — Ability Seal

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Seals a target’s most powerful active skill for 30 seconds. The target cannot use that skill. The seal is visible as a dark mark on the target.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 90 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Mordrach only

name: Lapse
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Slows the flow of time around a single target, making their movements and reactions noticeably sluggish for a short period.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Serapharch Active — Time Distortion

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a zone where time moves 50% slower for enemies. All enemy actions, projectiles, and Veyn effects within the zone are slowed. Lasts 8 seconds.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 90 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Serapharch only

name: Rewind
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Reverses the last few seconds of damage the user has taken, restoring the body to its previous state.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Serapharch Active — Temporal Reset

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Rewinds the angel’s personal state by 5 seconds — restoring HP, Veyn, and position to what they were. Does not affect enemies or allies. Cannot be used if the angel is dead.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 120 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Serapharch only

name: Still Hour
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Freezes a target in the brief moment between one breath and the next, locking them in place for a short time.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Serapharch Active — Time Freeze

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Freezes all enemies within 15 meters for 3 seconds. Frozen enemies cannot act, move, or take damage (they are invulnerable while frozen). The angel can reposition during the freeze.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 180 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: S-Grade

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Serapharch only

name: Long Sight
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Extends the user's vision across great distances within the realm, allowing them to spot threats long before they arrive.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord Active — Scrying

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The angel perceives all beings within 200 meters for 10 seconds. Hidden enemies are revealed. The angel can see through walls and obstacles. Cannot be blocked by most barriers.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 60 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: A-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord and above

name: Burning Path
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Leaves a glowing trail of light on the ground that scorches and damages anyone who steps across it.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord Active — Trail Attack

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The angel dashes forward, leaving a trail of Holy Fire that burns enemies for 8 seconds. The trail deals 5% max HP per second to enemies standing in it. Can be used to escape or engage.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 20 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: A-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord and above

name: Second Sun
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Creates a hovering sphere of intense light that blinds a target and marks them, making them easier to track and hit.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Serapharch Active — AoE Damage

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Summons a miniature sun above the battlefield for 6 seconds. All enemies take Holy Energy damage every second. Allies within the sun’s radius heal for 3% max HP per second.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 90 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: A-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Serapharch only

name: Battle Trance
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Pushes the user into a focused state where pain no longer interferes with movement or decision-making.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord Active — Frenzy

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The angel enters a combat trance for 15 seconds. Attack speed +40%, damage +25%, but defense -20%. Cannot be controlled or charmed during trance. Ends automatically or when the angel chooses.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 60 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: A-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord and above

name: Ravager’s Grasp
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Violently tears a weapon or shield from an opponent's hands using raw force mixed with Veyn.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord Active — Grab

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The angel grabs a target within 5 meters, lifting them off the ground. The target is stunned for 3 seconds and takes Holy Energy damage. Can be followed up with a throwing attack for bonus damage.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 30 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: A-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord and above

name: War-Worn
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: With every wound the user receives, their body becomes harder and more resistant to further damage.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Passive — Combat Experience

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: For every 10 seconds in continuous combat, the angel gains +2% damage and +1% damage reduction, stacking up to 10 times. Bonus resets 30 seconds after combat ends.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: None (passive)

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Virtue and above

name: Dread-Herald
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: The user speaks a single word of power that plants a deep, growing fear inside the target. The fear intensifies over time, steadily weakening the target’s will, slowing their movements, and making it harder for them to use skills. If the fear is allowed to fully mature, the target becomes temporarily paralyzed by terror or forced to flee. Stronger targets take longer to break, but the effect is harder to shake once it takes root.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord Active — Intimidation

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The angel projects an aura of divine dread. All enemies within 20 meters are feared for 4 seconds, running away from the angel. Fear breaks on damage. Enemies above the angel’s grade resist.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 45 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: A-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord and above

name: Unheralded
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: The user vanishes from sight and reappears instantly in a location where the target least expects them. The sudden appearance carries a brief disruptive force that staggers the opponent and leaves them open for a follow-up attack. The skill can be used in rapid succession, but each use after the first becomes harder to control and costs more Veyn.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Passive — Stealth Detection

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The angel automatically detects hidden, invisible, or cloaked enemies within 15 meters. Detected enemies are revealed to all allies. Does not require activation.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: None (passive)

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Virtue and above

name: Dreadweight
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Unleashes a crushing wave of pure dread that forces the target downward under its weight. The pressure slows their movements, weakens their stance, and makes it difficult for them to stay upright or use skills effectively. Stronger targets can resist being fully forced to their knees, but the oppressive weight still hampers them significantly.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord Active — Gravity

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Increases gravity in a 10-meter area for 6 seconds. Enemies within are slowed by 40%, their jump height is reduced to zero, and ranged attacks have reduced range. Flying enemies are grounded.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 45 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: A-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord and above

name: Altar-Rite
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Channels residual power similar to the Sundering Altar. The user can force a temporary magical binding on a target, locking them into a short-term condition or restriction (e.g., “cannot lie,” “cannot attack,” “cannot flee”) for a limited time. Stronger targets resist longer.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Serapharch Active — Ritual

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Performs a divine ritual at a Sundering Altar location. Doubles the effectiveness of any altar-based ability for 5 minutes. Can only be used at actual altar sites. Requires 10 seconds of uninterrupted channeling.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 600 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: A-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Serapharch only

name: Vowbrand
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Places a conditional curse on a target. If the target breaks a stated rule or promise, the curse activates — draining Veyn, weakening the body, or briefly locking their movements.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Passive — Vow Empowerment

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The angel’s Vow is branded into their weapon, increasing all weapon-based Holy Energy damage by 20%. If the angel breaks their Vow, this skill is lost permanently.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: None (passive)

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Virtue and above

name: Truthvein
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Allows the user to sense the truth behind spoken words. Lies, half-truths, and deceptions become clear. In combat, it also helps the user read feints and false openings.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Virtue Active — Detection

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Channels Holy Energy through the angel’s eyes, revealing lies and deceptions. Any being within 10 meters who speaks a falsehood is detected. Also reveals invisible text and hidden messages.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 30 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Virtue and above

name: All-Seeing Eye
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Grants the user complete awareness of everything happening within their designated area of watch at the same time.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Serapharch Active — Omniscience

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: For 5 seconds, the angel perceives everything within 500 meters — all creatures, all Veyn flows, all hidden objects, all illusions are revealed. Cannot be blocked by any means.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 180 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: A-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Serapharch only

name: Warden’s Recall
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Grants the user a perfect, unbreakable memory of everything they have ever personally witnessed. Every face, every conversation, every detail of a battlefield, every shift in expression is preserved with absolute clarity and can be recalled at will, no matter how much time has passed. This allows the user to notice patterns others miss, recognize people they saw only once years ago, and reconstruct events with flawless accuracy.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord Active — Teleport Ally

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Instantly teleports a targeted ally to the angel’s location. The ally must be within 100 meters and willing. Cannot be used in combat (both angel and target must be out of combat for 5 seconds).

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 60 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: A-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Aetherblade Lord and above

name: Warden’s Mark
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Places an invisible mark on a target that allows the user to track them anywhere within the realm.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Virtue Active — Mark

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Marks a target with a divine sigil for 30 seconds. All damage dealt to the marked target by any source is increased by 15%. The mark is visible through walls.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 20 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Virtue and above

name: Glut
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Forces far more Veyn into a target's body than it can safely contain, causing internal damage and disruption.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Gnash Active — Consumable Enhancement

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Consumes a food or potion item to gain double its effects. The consumed item must be in the demon’s inventory. Can only be used once per 10 minutes.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 600 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: D-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Gnash

name: Cornucopia
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Releases a wide burst of surplus Veyn in all directions, overwhelming and damaging weaker beings caught in the wave.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Gnash Active — Resource Generation

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Produces a small amount of random resources (food, basic materials, minor potions) from thin air. The quality and quantity scale with the demon’s grade. Cannot produce magical items.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 300 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: D-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Gnash

name: Reap
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: The user extends their power across the surrounding area and violently pulls Veyn from every weaker being within range. Streams of stolen energy are torn away from their targets and drawn directly into the user, simultaneously weakening everyone affected while rapidly restoring and amplifying the user’s own reserves.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Scourge Active — Harvest Attack

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: A sweeping attack that hits all enemies within 8 meters. Deals 150% weapon damage. Each enemy hit grants the demon +5% movement speed for 5 seconds (stacks).

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 15 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Scourge and above

name: Sovereign Aura
subtitle: Mastered skill
description: A refined and intensified form of Demonic Aura strong enough to force even other Bloodwards to feel heavy pressure and the urge to submit.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Mastered

name: Auralis Seal
subtitle: Personalized skill
description: Temporarily seals a target’s active abilities and aura, cutting them off from their power. While sealed, the target cannot use skills or project their aura and is forced to fight with only their physical strength and basic techniques. The duration depends on how much Veyn the user has available, and the consumption is extremely high, making it difficult to maintain for long.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Personalized

name: Time’s Grasp
subtitle: Mastered skill
description: Temporarily halts a single target's personal flow of time for a few heartbeats, freezing them in place.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Mastered

name: The Stolen Hour
subtitle: Personalized skill
description: Locks a target into a short time loop of their most recent actions (usually the last 3–5 seconds). While trapped, the target is forced to endlessly re-live that same moment and cannot act outside of it. The user remains free to move, attack, or reposition during the loop. Maintaining the ability drains Veyn continuously, and stronger targets can eventually force their way out.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Personalized

name: Blood-Oath
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: A contract sealed in the breaker’s own blood. Deadlier than a Blood Pact — it does not break when he dies, and whoever breaks it forfeits their Veyn to him.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Bloodward Active — Blood Contract

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a blood-sealed contract that is nearly impossible to break. The contract can enforce complex conditions. Breaking it deals 60% max HP damage and permanently marks the breaker.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 300 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Bloodward and above

name: Disinter
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Forces hidden or suppressed information to the surface. The user can drag out a target’s recent memories, sealed abilities, or buried emotions, temporarily exposing weaknesses, past injuries, or sealed powers. In combat, this can reveal openings or force a target’s hidden form/ability to surface against their will.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Mordrach Active — Corpse Animation

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Raises a powerful undead champion from a corpse. The champion has stats equal to 60% of the original creature’s stats and fights independently for 60 seconds. Only one champion at a time.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: 120 seconds

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: B-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Mordrach only

name: Guile
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: A carefully spoken lie that sinks into the target's mind and feels as if it has always been true.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Gnash Passive — Deception

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The demon is a natural deceiver. +30% success rate on all contract and negotiation skills. Also gains +15% evasion when fighting alone (enemies have trouble tracking the demon’s movements).

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: None (passive)

fields.label: Grade Requirement
fields.value: D-Grade or above

fields.label: Rank
fields.value: Gnash

name: Titles and Their Skills
subtitle: Every title carries its own skills
description: A title is more than a name — each one carries its own set of skills, mastered by the one who holds it. A title’s skills are distinct from a character’s innate rank abilities. Titles cannot be passed down; only a ruler of the first rank can grant a title to another, and only if they see that person as worthy of it. What can be passed down is a personalized skill — like Ordium’s The Stolen Hour or Lisa’s Auralis Seal — which flows from parent to offspring.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: World Mechanic - Named Abilities

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Unique skills from specific titles/positions. Cannot be learned - earned through achievement or bestowed by authority.

name: The Six Pillars of Angels
subtitle: The six generals of the Angel Realm
description: The Angel Realm’s six generals are known as the Six Pillars, ranked First through Sixth. The First Pillar is Chronous, held by Ordium; the Second through Sixth are Helious, Areous, Deimous, Horkous, and Argous. Each pillar bears a title, its own skills, and a duty — from guarding the Sundering Altar to standing as the Serapharch’s personal guard.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: World Mechanic - Angel Elite

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Six most powerful Aetherblade Lords under Clint Ashborn. Chronous (Time), Helious (Light), Areous (Fire), Deimous (Shadow), Horkous (Gravity), Argous (Steel).

name: The Six Fingers of Demons
subtitle: The six generals of the Demon Realm
description: The Demon Realm's six generals are known as the Six Fingers, ranked First through Sixth. Each Finger bears a title named after one of the deadly sins: Pride, Greed, Lust, Sloth, Gluttony, and Wrath. The First Finger is Pride, held by Laren Vornath; the Second through Sixth are Greed (Lisa, formerly), Lust (Isella Marrek), Sloth (Sythra Kaelis), Gluttony (Nyra Thessan), and Wrath (Licent Varak). Each Finger bears a title, its own skills, and a duty — from commanding armies to serving as the Mordrach's inner circle.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: World Mechanic - Demon Elite

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Six most powerful Bloodwards under Tera Morage. Pride (Misdirection), Greed (Overflow), Lust (Devotion), Sloth (Melancholy), Gluttony (Consumption), Wrath (Pursuit).

fields.label: Naming Convention
fields.value: The Six Fingers follow the deadly sins, mirroring how the Six Pillars follow Greek gods. Angels are named by gods; demons are named by sins.

name: Cherubim
subtitle: The throne-guardians — the apex angels
description: The highest type of angel, the guardians of the throne. The Serapharch — the ruler of the Angel Realm — is of this type. They are essentially immortal and can only be killed by a Divine Weapon or a Corrupted Divine Weapon (Vireth, the Fallen Grace).

fields.label: Innate Ability
fields.value: Imperishable

fields.label: Skin
fields.value: Luminous, pale gold like sunlight through marble, holding light rather than reflecting it, faintly radiant at the edges.

fields.label: Build
fields.value: Tall and statuesque, carrying themselves like living monuments, regal, unhurried, impossible to rush.

fields.label: Eyes
fields.value: Pure radiant gold with no visible pupil, glowing steady and calm with the same light as their halo.

fields.label: Presence
fields.value: Their Angelic Aura is so pure it visibly brightens the air around them, a quiet, overwhelming weight that makes lesser beings lower their gaze.

name: Malakhim
subtitle: The messenger host — the common true angels
description: The common type of true angel, the faithful host who take the Veyn Vow. The Aetherblade Lord Angels, Virtues, and Lumen all belong to this type.

fields.label: Innate Ability
fields.value: Veyn-Regen

fields.label: Skin
fields.value: Fair, luminous, holding a soft white-gold glow, less radiant than a Cherubim's deep gold luminance, but still clearly not human.

fields.label: Build
fields.value: Upright and disciplined, built for duty and combat readiness rather than a Cherubim's towering presence.

fields.label: Eyes
fields.value: Bright, pale gold or white, glowing steadily, matching the brightness of their halo.

fields.label: Presence
fields.value: Their Angelic Aura is clearly visible, a genuine glow and pressure in the air around them, though not as overwhelming as a Cherubim's.

name: Fallen Angels
subtitle: The broken — cast out for breaking the vow
description:
The type of angel who broke their own Veyn Vow and lost their halo to it. They keep their wings and power but can never take another vow, leaving their connection to Veyn unstable and unregulated.

---

## THE SANCTUARY BREAK

When an angel breaks their Vow through the deliberate betrayal of someone they swore to protect, the break triggers the Sanctuary Break. A void forms in the angel's Veyn channel where the promise used to resonate. Corrupted Veyn seeps into this void over weeks and months, consuming the angel's memories, emotions, and sense of self. The angel progresses through four stages: The Hollow (emptiness), The Fog (memory loss and paranoia), The Hunger (Veyn-draining compulsion), and The Hollowing (complete personality death). The Hollowed retain their former abilities and appearance but are driven by nothing but consumption. They are drawn to concentrations of Veyn and feed until stopped. The only reliable way to destroy a Hollowed is to overload the corrupted void with Veyn — requiring a Divine Weapon or a combined high-rank assault.

Not all Fallen Angels trigger a Sanctuary Break. Those who break their Vow through ordinary failure — weakness, doubt, cowardice — become standard Fallen Angels: damaged but stable, their Veyn unregulated but their mind intact. The Sanctuary Break only occurs through betrayal of a specific sworn obligation.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: Former angels with black spotted white wings or black cherry spotted white wings and a broken halo. The wings still carry the rank-based wing count of their former status, but the feathers are permanently marked with dark spots where corrupted Veyn surged through when the vow shattered.

fields.label: Innate Ability
fields.value: Rapid-Mend

fields.label: Sanctuary Break
fields.value: Triggered by betrayal of a sworn obligation. Void forms in Veyn channel; corrupted Veyn seeps in over time, consuming identity. Four stages: Hollow → Fog → Hunger → Hollowing.

name: Imperishable
subtitle: Innate ability
description: Cannot be struck down by ordinary means — only a Divine Weapon or a Corrupted Divine Weapon can end them.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Innate Ability — Undying

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The being cannot be killed by conventional means. When reduced to 0 HP, they enter a 10-second stasis and regenerate to 30% HP. Can only trigger once per hour. Does not protect against soul destruction or Veyn annihilation.

fields.label: Rarity
fields.value: Extremely rare — found in Aelthar remnants and ancient beings

name: Veyn-Regen
subtitle: Innate ability
description: Their Veyn replenishes on its own, faster than it drains.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Innate Ability — Veyn Regeneration

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Passively regenerates Veyn at 2% of max capacity per second. This is 4x faster than normal regeneration. Cannot be suppressed or drained below 0.

fields.label: Rarity
fields.value: Common among high-ranking angels and demons

name: Rapid-Mend
subtitle: Innate ability
description: Their regeneration speeds up in bursts, mending wounds quicker than it should.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Innate Ability — Healing Factor

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Regenerates physical wounds at 5x normal speed. Minor cuts heal in seconds, broken bones in minutes, severed limbs in hours. Does not work on Veyn damage or soul injuries.

fields.label: Rarity
fields.value: Common among demons, rare among humans

name: Fiends
subtitle: The apex demons
description: The highest type of demon, the rulers of the Demon Realm. The Mordrach are of this type — they cannot be killed by regular or holy weapons, only by a Divine Weapon.

fields.label: Innate Ability
fields.value: Sovereign Resilience

fields.label: Skin
fields.value: Deep onyx-black, almost absorbing light, with faint ember-orange cracks like cooling magma at the edges of their horns and fingers.

fields.label: Build
fields.value: Towering, broad, heavy, they carry themselves like living thrones.

fields.label: Eyes
fields.value: Smoldering embers, no visible pupil, shedding a faint heat-haze.

fields.label: Presence
fields.value: Their Demonic Aura is so thick it visibly darkens the air around them.

name: Dregs
subtitle: The common demons
description: The common type of demon, the rank-and-file of the Demon Realm. The Bloodward, Scourge, and Gnash all belong to this type.

fields.label: Innate Ability
fields.value: Vitality-Regen

fields.label: Skin
fields.value: Rough, ashen or bruised-purple, scarred and battle-worn.

fields.label: Build
fields.value: Varied but hardened, soldier-like, lean and coiled.

fields.label: Eyes
fields.value: Bloodshot amber or sickly yellow, no warmth.

fields.label: Presence
fields.value: A faint, constant oppressive hum, lesser than a Fiend's, but always felt.

name: Imps
subtitle: The impish demons
description: A demon type set apart from the ordinary Dregs — the impish few, including Lisa and Laren Vornath the 1st Finger, Pride, and the MC’s demon half.

fields.label: Innate Ability
fields.value: Veyn-Touch

fields.label: Skin
fields.value: Warmer and less monstrous than a Dreg's, closer to a deep violet or plum tone rather than ash or bruise-purple, unsettling mostly in how normal it can look at a glance.

fields.label: Build
fields.value: Lithe and human-passing, more agile than hardened, built for misdirection rather than raw force.

fields.label: Eyes
fields.value: Sharp, alert, with a flicker of amusement even in danger, unlike a Dreg's flat hostility.

fields.label: Presence
fields.value: Their aura doesn't press down the way a Fiend's or Dreg's does, it unsettles more subtly, a playful-cruel undertone that makes people uneasy without knowing exactly why.

name: Sovereign Resilience
subtitle: Innate ability
description:
Cannot be harmed or killed by regular weapons — only a Divine Weapon can end them.
They can be damaged by a holy weapon

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Innate Ability — Mental Fortitude

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Immunity to all forms of mental influence: charm, fear, mind control, memory alteration, and emotional manipulation. The being’s will cannot be broken by any external force.

fields.label: Rarity
fields.value: Found in Mordrach-rank demons and Serapharch-rank angels

name: Vitality-Regen
subtitle: Innate ability
description: Their regeneration runs on Veyn or Vitality, replenishing faster than it drains.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Innate Ability — HP Regeneration

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Passively regenerates HP at 1% of max capacity per second. Combined with Rapid-Mend, the being is extremely difficult to kill through attrition.

fields.label: Rarity
fields.value: Common among high-ranking beings of all races

name: Veyn-Touch
subtitle: Innate ability
description: Can drain the Veyn of others without them knowing or feeling it — only a slight discomfort.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Innate Ability — Veyn Manipulation

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Can manipulate raw Veyn without a class or skill. Allows basic Veyn attacks, shields, and detection without formal training. The的基础 for all Veyn-based abilities.

fields.label: Rarity
fields.value: Universal — all beings with Veyn channels have this at some level

name: Angel Evolution
subtitle: How a new Serapharch is made
description: To become the first rank — the Serapharch — the heir is flooded with a massive amount of Veyn, then exposed to ten days of raw, concentrated Veyn. If they survive, they evolve into a Cherubim angel and become the new ruler of the Angel Realm. This rite is performed on the heir, and only after the king has died or has given up the throne.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: World Mechanic - Rank Progression

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Lumen to Virtue to Aetherblade Lord to Serapharch. Each evolution: new skills, more Veyn, physical changes (wings, halo). Requires training and Vow breakthrough.

name: Demon Evolution
subtitle: How a new Mordrach is made
description: To evolve from a Dregs demon to a Fiend — the Mordrach — the first rank must die. When that happens, all the Veyn the first rank held while alive is passed on to the next heir; if the heir can withstand it, they become the new king of the Demon Realm.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: World Mechanic - Rank Progression

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Gnash to Scourge to Bloodward to Mordrach. Each evolution: new skills, more Corrupted Veyn, physical changes (horns, size). Requires combat and Pact breakthrough.

name: Race Types
subtitle: Species, separate from rank
description: Beyond their rank, every angel and demon belongs to a race type — a kind of being, not a position. The angels have three types: the Cherubim (the throne-guardian apex), the Malakhim (the common true angels), and the Fallen Angels (the vow-breakers). The demons have three: the Fiends (the apex), the Dregs (the common demons), and the Imps (the impish few set apart from the ordinary line). Race type and rank are independent — a Serapharch and a Lumen are both angels, but at different ranks of the same kind.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: World Mechanic - Species

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Humans, Angels (4 ranks), Demons (4 ranks), Elves (2 types), Aelthar (extinct), Vileth (parasitic), Vilethsworn (demonic humans), plus monsters and beings.

name: Innate Abilities
subtitle: One per race type
description: Each race type carries one innate ability, shared by every member of that type regardless of rank. These are distinct from learned skills: they are born into the blood, not trained. The Cherubim are Imperishable, the Malakhim carry Veyn-Regen, and the Fallen Angels carry Rapid-Mend; the Fiends are Sovereign Resilience, the Dregs carry Vitality-Regen, and the Imps carry Veyn-Touch.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: World Mechanic - Born Powers

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Inherent abilities: Imperishable, Veyn-Regen, Rapid-Mend, etc. Cannot be taught, copied, or stolen. Scale with grade.

name: Mastered and Personalized Skills
subtitle: The two highest tiers of skill
description: Beyond ordinary skills, a character can reach two higher tiers. A Mastered skill is one they have perfected beyond what their rank normally allows — their peak. A Personalized skill is their signature, unique to them alone, forged from their own experience. These are the skills that can be passed down to an offspring, and they mark the few who stand above their rank.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: World Mechanic - Peak Skills

fields.label: Description
fields.value: At skill peak: Master (perfect, no cooldown) or Personalize (modify to unique Veyn signature). Only 1 in 1000 achieve this.

name: The Hybrid
subtitle: Angel and demon in one body
description: A hybrid is an angel and a demon born of a single body — a union the world considers impossible, since Veyn and Ren cannot coexist and the two realms’ natures are opposed. Jaiden Marlock is the first, born of Ordium (an Aetherblade Lord Angel) and Lisa (a Bloodward), and his aura carries both an angelic and a demonic aura at once. Hybrids inherit both parents’ race types — in Jaiden’s case the Imp demon half and the Malakhim angel half — and can draw on the abilities of both. Because such a being has never existed before, there are no rules for it, only what Jaiden himself becomes. A hybrid cannot take the Veyn Vow: the vow is a single promise sworn into one halo, but a hybrid holds two natures in one body — an angel’s light and a demon’s dark — and no single promise can bind both at once. The vow was simply never made for a being like him.

fields.label: The Vow
fields.value: A hybrid cannot take the Veyn Vow — no single promise can bind two natures. The Angel Realm would still demand it, and would reject him when he cannot give it.

name: Spirits
subtitle: Not demons — something else
description: Not every creature of the Dark belongs to the Demon Realm’s ranks. Some are spirits — beings given shape by unstable Veyn rather than born of the demonic bloodline. The Cindergrave Wraith Lord and the Lesser Cindergrave Wraiths are evil spirits: fragments of will pulled from the fallen kingdom of Lethmoor and held together by the unstable Veyn of its terrain. They are not demons and hold no demon rank; they simply endure where the Veyn is too broken to be called a realm, feeding on the Veyn of the living to stay whole.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: World Mechanic - Non-Physical Beings

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Entities without physical form: Cindergrave Wraiths, Echoes of the Fallen, spectral beings. Summoned/bound/banished with Exorcist skills.

name: Aelthar
subtitle: The extinct realm-makers
description: An extinct race, wiped out by the former ruler of the Human Realm, forcing the survivors to flee by tearing open the Hidden Realm as a hiding place — an act so violent it nearly destroyed the world outright. Escaping the ruler didn’t save them: once inside, the realm’s own creatures began forming almost immediately, and the Aelthar had no way to survive against them. Nearly the entire race died out inside the very refuge they built, save for one survivor — the Headmaster of the Academy — who alone learned to endure it and later became the only person to ever successfully brew the Ethereal Potion.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: Pale, ash-grey skin; flat, dark eyes that do not reflect light; faint markings that glow faintly with Veyn beneath the skin.

fields.label: Innate Ability
fields.value: Potent Blood

fields.label: Curse
fields.value: Cursed by the world core for tearing open the Hidden Realm — every Aelthar bore the rune collar.

name: Potent Blood
subtitle: Innate ability
description: Their blood has an extremely high, potent healing capability, and is an excellent conduit for magic — allowing them to use powerful magic easily.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Innate Ability — Blood Power

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The being’s blood is unusually potent. Blood-based attacks deal 50% more damage. Blood-forging with their blood produces superior results. If their blood is consumed by others, it grants temporary power boosts.

fields.label: Rarity
fields.value: Found in demon royalty and ancient bloodlines

name: The Aelthar
subtitle: The extinct race of the Hidden Realm
description: The Aelthar were an ancient race of realm-makers, wiped out by the former ruler of the Human Realm. Their survivors tore open the Hidden Realm as a hiding place, an act so violent it nearly destroyed the world, but even that refuge could not save them — the realm’s creatures formed almost immediately and the Aelthar died out inside it, leaving one survivor: the Headmaster of the Academy, who alone learned to endure the realm and became the only person to ever brew the Ethereal Potion.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: World Mechanic - Extinct Race

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Original world rulers. Created Shudon, discovered World Eater, wrote Sealed Writings. Wiped out in Sundering. Only Kael von Ashen survives.

name: The World Barrier
subtitle: Its magical origins
description: The world barrier was raised to split the realms apart after the old race’s tearing-open of the Hidden Realm nearly destroyed the world. Its magic is drawn directly from the untouched world core — the same primal source from which Veyn is pulled — rather than from any single caster, which is why it has endured without ever being re-made. The Shudon, stone golems carved from the world core, were set at the entrances to the three main realms — Human, Angel, and Demon — to guard the barrier and keep the world from collapsing inward. The Hidden Realm has no Shudon; its only entrance is the wandering portal.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: World Mechanic - Realm Separation

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Barrier separating four realms. Created in Sundering. Slowly weakening - Fourth Turning determines if mended or destroyed. Permeable to Veyn, blocks physical passage except via Realm Gates.

name: The World Core
subtitle: The untouched heart of the world
description: The world core has no mind and no body — only a will. It is the untouched source from which all Veyn flows into the world, but it does not think or feel the way a living thing does. When the world was put in danger — when the old race tore open the Hidden Realm and nearly destroyed everything — the core’s will answered on its own, raising the world barrier to split the realms apart and carving the Shudon from its own stone to guard the three main realms’ entrances against collapse.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: World Mechanic - Supreme Entity

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Source of all Veyn. Whether conscious is the central theological question. Humans: Dreamer. Angels: Arbiter. Demons: Fuel. World Eater draining it.

name: Holy Energy and Corrupted Veyn
subtitle: The two opposing poles of Veyn
description: Holy energy and corrupted Veyn are the two opposite poles of Veyn — one purified into gold, the other darkened into black. They are naturally at war with each other: holy energy burns corruption on contact, while corrupted Veyn contaminates and corrodes holy auras and holy energy. When they clash directly, they cancel each other out — Holy Flame and Purgatory Flames each consume the other rather than one overcoming the other.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: World Mechanic - Energy Types

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Holy Energy: purified Veyn through Vow. Corrupted Veyn: tainted by World Eater. Opposite polarities. Using both causes Saturation Sickness unless Hybrid.

name: The Three Forms of Veyn
subtitle: Humans, angels, and demons
description: The three peoples of the world each draw on a different form of Veyn. Humans use raw Veyn — neutral and silver-blue, the unshaped source itself. Angels channel Holy Energy — Veyn purified into gold. Demons wield Corrupted Veyn — Veyn darkened into miasma. All three trace back to the same world core; they are not separate powers, but one Veyn expressed three ways, each reflecting the nature of those who use it.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: World Mechanic - Energy States

fields.label: Description
fields.value: 1) Pure Veyn (natural), 2) Holy Energy (purified through Vow), 3) Corrupted Veyn (tainted by Eater). All from World Core. Balance determines stability.

name: The Formation of Holy Energy and Corrupted Veyn
subtitle: How raw Veyn becomes gold or black
description: Both holy energy and corrupted Veyn are made from the same raw Veyn, but by opposite processes. Holy energy is formed through purification: a holy being burns away Veyn’s impurity — an angel through the promise of their halo and Veyn Vow, a saint or diviner through their own holy channeling — brightening the Veyn from silver-blue into gold. Corrupted Veyn is formed through corruption: a demon turns its own Veyn inward and decomposes it into miasma, darkening and poisoning it until it stains a deep purple or black. One Veyn pulled in two directions — which is exactly why they cannot coexist and cancel each other out when they meet.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: World Mechanic - Origin

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Holy Energy formed when Aelthar created Vow system. Corrupted Veyn formed when World Eater began draining Core. Both deviations from Pure Veyn.

name: Silver Sigil
subtitle: The lowest coin
description: The lowest tier of currency, used for everyday purchases. One hundred silver sigils are worth one gold sigil.

fields.label: Value
fields.value: 1 silver = 1/100 gold

fields.label: Tier
fields.value: Lowest

name: Gold Sigil
subtitle: The middle coin
description: The middle tier of currency. One gold sigil is worth one hundred silver, and one thousand gold sigils are worth one platinum sigil.

fields.label: Value
fields.value: 1 gold = 100 silver; 1,000 gold = 1 platinum

fields.label: Tier
fields.value: Middle

name: Platinum Sigil
subtitle: The highest coin
description: The highest tier of currency, reserved for large transactions and wealth. One platinum sigil is worth one thousand gold, or one hundred thousand silver.

fields.label: Value
fields.value: 1 platinum = 1,000 gold = 100,000 silver

fields.label: Tier
fields.value: Highest

name: Aldermere
subtitle: The kingdom of the Human Realm
description: The ruling kingdom of the Human Realm, seat of Ruby Divina. Unlike the other realms’ capitals, Aldermere governs no rigid caste or rank — its people are the varied hundreds of thousands of humanity, and its ruler holds power through political skill and the trust of that population rather than divine right or raw strength.

fields.label: Ruler
fields.value: Ruby Divina

name: Aurelion
subtitle: The kingdom of the Angel Realm
description: The ruling kingdom of the Angel Realm, seat of the Serapharch Clint Ashborn. Built around the throne, it is home to the angels’ promises at their purest — the Six Pillars, the Veyn Vows, and the ranks kept by sworn word. Its population numbers only in the tens of thousands, small enough to be governed perfectly.

fields.label: Ruler
fields.value: Clint Ashborn

name: Vorath
subtitle: The kingdom of the Demon Realm
description: The ruling kingdom of the Demon Realm, seat of the Mordrach Tera Morage. A city that never sleeps, its hundreds of thousands churning as demons kill their way up the ranks and breed to fill what battle empties. It is the only realm capital that fields endless armies.

fields.label: Ruler
fields.value: Tera Morage

name: Hybrid Fusion
subtitle: The mutated skills of the True Hybrid Form
description: When Jaiden Marlock enters his True Hybrid Form, the skills of his two bloodlines stop being separate sets. Each skill of the Aetherblade Lord Angel rank and each skill of the Bloodward demon rank mutate and fuse together, one with another, becoming a single hybrid skill that neither race could wield alone. The fused skills draw on Holy Energy and Corrupted Veyn at once, and exist only while the hybrid form is held.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: World Mechanic - Jaiden-Unique

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Fusing Holy Energy and Corrupted Veyn into unified power. Only with Auralis Ruby in a hybrid. Grants access to both Angel and Demon skill trees simultaneously.

name: Hybrid Skills
subtitle: The fused skills of the hybrid
description: The mutated skills of Jaiden Marlock’s True Hybrid Form. When he enters it, each of his Aetherblade Lord Angel rank skills fuses with a Bloodward demon rank skill, becoming a single hybrid skill that neither race could wield alone. They draw on Holy Energy and Corrupted Veyn at once.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Skills exclusive to the Hybrid form — only accessible to Jaiden Marlock in True Hybrid form.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: Fused from both Angel and Demon skill trees simultaneously. The skills combine Holy Energy and Corrupted Veyn into something entirely new.

fields.label: Unique
fields.value: No other being in history has been able to use these skills. They are the physical manifestation of the Sundering being mended.

name: Twilight Chains
subtitle: Hybrid skill
description: Conjures thick chains woven from hardened holy light and living blood. The chains bind with far greater strength than either Skyward Chains or Blood Chains alone. Wherever they touch, they burn with holy fire while simultaneously drinking the target’s strength and Veyn. The more the victim struggles, the tighter and hungrier the chains become, rapidly exhausting even strong opponents.

fields.label: Fuses
fields.value: Skyward Chains + Blood Chains

fields.label: Form
fields.value: True Hybrid Form

name: Cry of the Sundered
subtitle: Hybrid skill
description: A single, dual-natured battle cry that carries both angelic authority and demonic dominance. Allies who hear it feel their strength, speed, and resolve surge, while enemies experience a sudden collapse of will — their bodies hesitating and their skills faltering for a critical moment. The effect is strong enough to turn the momentum of a battle in a single breath.

fields.label: Fuses
fields.value: Vanguard's Cry + Warcry of Dominion

fields.label: Form
fields.value: True Hybrid Form

name: Hollow Aegis
subtitle: Hybrid skill
description: Forms a layered barrier of solidified light and hardened blood. The ward is significantly tougher than either Aegis Ward or Crimson Ward alone. Instead of only draining the user’s regeneration, it absorbs a portion of the force from incoming attacks and converts it into restorative energy, partially healing the user with every blow it blocks.

fields.label: Fuses
fields.value: Aegis Ward + Crimson Ward

fields.label: Form
fields.value: True Hybrid Form

name: Mend-and-Rot
subtitle: Hybrid skill
description: A dual-natured touch that heals and corrupts at the same time. Allies struck by it are rapidly healed by pure holy light, while enemies suffer rotting, decomposing Veyn that eats through flesh and magic. The energy taken from the corrupted side is recycled to fuel the healing, allowing the user to restore allies without fully draining their own reserves.

fields.label: Fuses
fields.value: Holy Mend + Veyn Decomposition (Bloodward)

fields.label: Form
fields.value: True Hybrid Form

name: Aura of the Split Crown
subtitle: Hybrid skill
description: The complete fusion of an Aetherblade’s Angelic Aura and a Bloodward’s Demonic Aura. Those weaker than the user are crushed by two opposing forces at once — the overwhelming urge to kneel in submission and the primal instinct to flee in terror. The conflicting pressure shatters focus, slows reactions, and makes sustained resistance extremely difficult.

fields.label: Fuses
fields.value: Angelic Aura (Aetherblade) + Demonic Aura (Bloodward)

fields.label: Form
fields.value: True Hybrid Form

name: Frenzied Step
subtitle: Hybrid skill
description: A rage-fueled blink that combines Swiftstep with the Bloodward’s Berserk state. The user vanishes and reappears behind a target in an instant, each use feeding their growing frenzy. With every step, their strength multiplies and their movements become faster and harder to track, until they are little more than a blur of overwhelming force.

fields.label: Fuses
fields.value: Swiftstep + Berserk (Bloodward)

fields.label: Form
fields.value: True Hybrid Form

name: Gloaming Veil
subtitle: Hybrid skill
description: The perfect fusion of Dawnveil and Duskveil. The user can completely erase all traces of their hybrid nature, both auras, wings, horns, and halo. Even under close magical scrutiny, the disguise holds firm, making them appear as an ordinary human or whichever form they choose to present. Maintaining it still carries a cost, but far less than using either veil separately.

fields.label: Fuses
fields.value: Dawnveil (Aetherblade) + Duskveil (Bloodward)

fields.label: Form
fields.value: True Hybrid Form

name: The World Curse
subtitle: A curse given by the world core
description: Forms a rune collar around the person’s neck. The bearer is unavoidably hunted by the Shudon when spotted and will be killed. The curse was first laid by the world core upon the Aelthar, as punishment for tearing open the Hidden Realm and nearly destroying the world — a mark the will of the world placed on an entire race for the crime of nearly unmaking it.

fields.label: Brand
fields.value: Makes a rune-like design around the person’s neck and can awaken the golems to hunt the person down. With this mark on, teleportation out of the realm or place is blocked and rendered unusable.

fields.label: Ban
fields.value: Blocks any use of teleportation out of the realm, and the bearer is hunted down and killed by the Shudon. This means you are locked down and stuck in the realm you were in when you got it.

fields.label: Mark
fields.value: This mark can’t be hidden or removed by any means.

fields.label: Origin
fields.value: First laid on the Aelthar by the world core, for tearing open the Hidden Realm.

name: Piercing Lance
subtitle: Mage skill
description: Fires a concentrated spear of raw Veyn that explodes on impact. At its most basic, the lance is little more than a sharp bolt of silver-blue energy — fast, damaging, but easily blocked by even a basic Veyn barrier. The caster can release it quickly for lower damage or charge it longer for a stronger blast. Main mid-range attack for any practicing Mage. The lance leaves a faint trail of dissolved air in its wake, and the explosion on impact sends shards of residual Veyn scattering in a small radius.

fields.label: Rune Star Circle
fields.value: 1st Circle

fields.label: Unlock Requirement
fields.value: Basic offensive spell — the first spell any Mage learns. A concentrated spear of raw Veyn that explodes on impact.

name: Glass Bastion
subtitle: Mage skill
description: Creates a translucent wall of condensed Veyn that blocks physical and magical attacks. At its most basic, the wall is thin and brittle — it can stop a sword swing or a low-level spell, but sustained fire or a heavy blow will shatter it. Strength and duration depend entirely on how much Veyn the caster pours into it. The wall shimmers with a faint silver-blue light, and cracks appear along its surface as it absorbs damage. Once it breaks, the Veyn dissipates into nothing.

fields.label: Rune Star Circle
fields.value: 1st Circle

fields.label: Unlock Requirement
fields.value: Basic defensive spell — creates a translucent wall of condensed Veyn that blocks physical and magical attacks.

name: Echo Sense
subtitle: Mage skill
description: Heightens the user's sensitivity to Veyn, allowing them to detect living beings, hidden magic, and changes in ambient density. At its most basic, the sense is vague and imprecise — the caster can tell something is nearby but not exactly where or what.
