It feels like a faint hum at the back of the skull, growing louder as the source draws nearer. The range is short, perhaps fifty meters, and the sense can be overwhelmed by strong Veyn sources.

fields.label: Rune Star Circle
fields.value: 1st Circle

fields.label: Unlock Requirement
fields.value: Basic utility spell — heightens sensitivity to Veyn, allowing detection of living beings, hidden magic, and ambient density changes.

name: Elemental Brand
subtitle: Mage skill
description: Converts raw Veyn into fire, ice, lightning, or wind and releases it as a focused attack. At its most basic, the conversion is crude — the element is unstable and loses potency quickly. Each element carries a secondary effect: fire burns, ice slows, lightning stuns, wind pushes. The caster must choose one element per casting and cannot switch mid-attack. The brand appears as a glowing sigil on the caster's palm before the element erupts outward.

fields.label: Rune Star Circle
fields.value: 2nd Circle

fields.label: Unlock Requirement
fields.value: Converts raw Veyn into fire, ice, lightning, or wind and releases it as a focused attack. Each element carries a secondary effect.

name: Leechfield
subtitle: Mage skill
description: Draws ambient Veyn from the surroundings to restore the user's reserves. At its most basic, the draw is slow and inefficient — the caster must stand still and focus, making them vulnerable. Works faster in high-density Veyn areas. Cannot be used while casting other spells. The field manifests as a faint vortex of silver particles spiraling into the caster's body, and the surrounding area dims slightly as Veyn is drained.

fields.label: Rune Star Circle
fields.value: 3rd Circle

fields.label: Unlock Requirement
fields.value: Draws ambient Veyn from the surroundings to restore the user's reserves. Works faster in high-density areas. Cannot be used while casting other spells.

name: Skyvault
subtitle: Mage skill
description: Forms a large protective dome of Veyn around the user and nearby allies. At its most basic, the dome is thin and temporary — it can absorb a few hits before failing. Blocks attacks from all directions as long as the user maintains the supply of Veyn. The dome appears as a translucent hemisphere of shimmering light, and the caster must remain stationary to maintain it. The larger the dome, the faster the Veyn drains.

fields.label: Rune Star Circle
fields.value: 3rd Circle

fields.label: Unlock Requirement
fields.value: Forms a large protective dome of Veyn around the user and nearby allies. Blocks attacks from all directions as long as the user maintains the supply of Veyn.

name: Repulse
subtitle: Mage skill
description: Releases a radial burst of raw Veyn that knocks enemies back and disrupts concentration. At its most basic, the burst is weak — it pushes enemies a few steps back and causes momentary disorientation. Used to create space in close combat. The shockwave radiates outward from the caster in a visible ripple of silver energy, and the ground beneath them cracks slightly from the force.

fields.label: Rune Star Circle
fields.value: 2nd Circle

fields.label: Unlock Requirement
fields.value: Releases a radial burst of raw Veyn that knocks enemies back and disrupts concentration. Used to create space in close combat.

name: Bloodthread
subtitle: Mage skill
description: Creates a visible Veyn thread linking the user to one or more allies. At its most basic, the thread is fragile — it can share small amounts of Veyn and basic spell support, but breaks if the distance becomes too great or if either party takes heavy damage. The thread glows faintly along its length, and both parties can feel a subtle tug when the other is in danger.

fields.label: Rune Star Circle
fields.value: 4th Circle

fields.label: Unlock Requirement
fields.value: Creates a visible Veyn thread linking the user to one or more allies. Allows sharing of Veyn reserves and limited spell support. Breaks if the distance becomes too great.

name: Shiftstate
subtitle: Mage skill
description: Temporarily converts the user's Veyn between raw, elemental, and purified states. At its most basic, the conversion is unstable and brief — the caster can only maintain the shifted state for a few seconds before it reverts. Enables more flexible spell combinations but requires precise control. The Veyn visibly changes color during the shift: raw is silver-blue, elemental takes on the color of the element, purified glows white.

fields.label: Rune Star Circle
fields.value: 5th Circle

fields.label: Unlock Requirement
fields.value: Temporarily converts the user's Veyn between raw, elemental, and purified states. Enables more flexible spell combinations but requires precise control.

name: Absolute Flow
subtitle: Mage skill
description: Grants advanced control over Veyn. Allows casting multiple spells at once, shaping Veyn with high precision, and reducing the cost of all other Mage abilities. At its most basic, the control is limited — the caster can maintain two spells simultaneously and reduce costs by a small margin. The Veyn flows visibly through the caster's body in intricate patterns, and their eyes glow with a steady silver light.

fields.label: Rune Star Circle
fields.value: 6th Circle

fields.label: Unlock Requirement
fields.value: Grants advanced control over Veyn. Allows casting multiple spells at once, shaping Veyn with high precision, and reducing the cost of all other Mage abilities.

name: Toniccraft
subtitle: Alchemist skill
description: Combines Veyn and ingredients to create healing, restorative, or enhancement potions. At its most basic, the brews are simple — a basic healing potion that closes minor cuts, a restorative tonic that eases fatigue. Quality depends entirely on the materials and the alchemist's skill. The brewing process requires a mortar, heat source, and at least one Veyn-reactive ingredient. A failed batch results in a foul-smelling liquid that has no effect.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Basic healing tonic creation. Heals 15% HP over 10 seconds. Requires 1 reagent.

name: Nightbrew
subtitle: Alchemist skill
description: Creates toxic concoctions that can paralyze, weaken, or cause lingering damage. At its most basic, the poisons are mild — they cause numbness in the affected area, brief dizziness, or minor irritation. Can be applied to weapons or delivered through food and drink. The brewer must wear protective gloves during mixing, as the toxins are as dangerous to the maker as the target if mishandled.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Brews a potion that enhances night vision and Veyn sensitivity for 30 minutes.

name: Shattervial
subtitle: Alchemist skill
description: Brews volatile mixtures that explode on impact or command. At its most basic, the blast is small — enough to startle and burn, but not lethal. Blast size and force can be adjusted by changing ingredients and Veyn input. The vials are fragile and must be stored carefully, as accidental breakage can injure the alchemist. Each vial glows faintly with the color of its explosive compound.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Throws a vial that shatters on impact, dealing 120% Corrupted Veyn damage in a 3m radius.

name: Trueassay
subtitle: Alchemist skill
description: Instantly identifies the magical properties, purity, and potential uses of any ingredient through touch or a light Veyn probe. At its most basic, the identification is surface-level — the alchemist can tell if an ingredient is toxic, magical, or mundane, but cannot determine exact potency. The probe feels like a warm pulse extending from the fingertips into the material.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Analyzes any substance or creature, revealing composition, weaknesses, and hidden properties.

name: Overcharge
subtitle: Alchemist skill
description: Channels extra Veyn into a potion during brewing, greatly increasing its final strength. At its most basic, the overcharge adds a marginal boost — perhaps 10-15% stronger than a standard brew. Requires careful control to avoid ruining the brew, as too much Veyn destabilizes the mixture. The alchemist must maintain steady hand contact with the brewing vessel throughout the process.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Overcharges a potion to double its effect, but with a 20% chance of backlash damage.

name: Multiplier
subtitle: Alchemist skill
description: Creates special substances that multiply or alter the effects of other potions when combined with them. At its most basic, the multiplier is a simple amplifier — it doubles the effect of a single potion. The substance appears as a fine, iridescent powder that must be added at the exact right moment in the brewing process.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Brews 3 copies of a single potion instead of 1. Requires 3x the reagents.

name: Cleansebrew
subtitle: Alchemist skill
description: Removes toxins, corruption, and impurities from ingredients or finished potions. At its most basic, the cleanse can remove minor contamination — a slightly spoiled herb, a potion that has turned murky. Can also cleanse small amounts of contaminated Veyn. The process involves submerging the ingredient in a purification solution and channeling Veyn through it.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Brews a purifying tonic that removes all negative status effects from one target.

name: Mattershift
subtitle: Alchemist skill
description: Changes the physical state or basic composition of ingredients so they can be used in recipes they normally could not enter. At its most basic, the shift is minor — turning a solid powder into a liquid, or changing the color and texture of a herb. The shift is temporary and reverts after a few minutes unless stabilized.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Transforms one type of reagent into another. Limited to common materials.

name: Hastybrew
subtitle: Alchemist skill
description: Allows rapid brewing of a functional potion during combat using whatever materials are on hand. At its most basic, the potion is rough — it works, but the effect is weaker and the taste is terrible. Results are rougher but still usable. The alchemist must identify suitable ingredients in seconds and mix them by hand, relying on instinct and experience.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Brews a potion in 5 seconds instead of the normal 30. Quality reduced by 15%.

name: Mythic Draught
subtitle: Alchemist skill
description: Creates complex, multi-layered legendary potions with powerful and lasting effects. At its most basic, the draught requires rare ingredients and high control — the alchemist must maintain perfect Veyn channeling for hours while the potion brews. A single mistake wastes the entire batch. The finished product glows with an inner light and radiates a faint hum of power.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Ultimate brew. Creates a potion that grants temporary access to one skill from any class for 60 seconds. Requires rare reagents.

name: Heartbind
subtitle: Beastmaster skill
description: Forms a deep telepathic bond with a willing creature. At its most basic, the bond is one-directional — the beastmaster can sense the creature's emotions but cannot project their own thoughts. Once accepted, both can sense each other's emotions and general intentions. Cannot be forced. The bond manifests as a warm glow in the chest when the creature is nearby.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Bonds with a beast permanently. The beast gains +20% stats and obeys commands perfectly.

name: Thoughtlink
subtitle: Beastmaster skill
description: Deepens the bond so the user and creature can exchange more complex thoughts and feelings beyond basic intent. At its most basic, the exchange is limited to images and emotions — the beastmaster can share a picture of what they want the creature to do, but not detailed verbal commands. The link feels like a second set of senses overlaid on their own.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Establishes telepathic link with bonded beast. Can share senses and commands silently.

name: Pack Order
subtitle: Beastmaster skill
description: Issues clear, instantaneous combat orders to the bonded creature through the bond. At its most basic, the orders are simple — attack, defend, retreat. The creature responds as if the order were instinct. The bond carries emotional weight, so the creature feels the urgency behind each command.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Commands all bonded beasts in 20m radius to attack simultaneously. +25% damage per beast.

name: Beast Eye
subtitle: Beastmaster skill
description: Allows the user to see, hear, and feel through the bonded creature's senses for a limited time. At its most basic, the shared senses last only a few seconds and cause disorientation when switching back. Range depends on bond strength. The beastmaster's eyes briefly take on the color of the creature's eyes during the transfer.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Sees through the eyes of any bonded beast within 1km. Can switch between beasts freely.

name: Feral Rush
subtitle: Beastmaster skill
description: Channels Ren into the bonded creature, temporarily increasing its speed, strength, and durability. At its most basic, the boost is moderate — the creature moves about 30% faster and hits harder for a short duration. Cost is shared between user and creature. The beast's fur or scales glow faintly with crimson energy during the rush.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: All bonded beasts enter frenzy for 10 seconds. +40% attack speed, -20% defense.

name: Fleshguard
subtitle: Beastmaster skill
description: Commands the creature to intercept an attack aimed at the user, using its body as a barrier. At its most basic, the creature responds quickly but takes full damage from the attack. The bond ensures the creature acts without hesitation, even against threats far stronger than itself.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: A bonded beast intercepts a lethal attack, taking the damage instead. Beast survives at 1 HP.

name: Twin Fang
subtitle: Beastmaster skill
description: Times the user's attack and the creature's attack to land on the same target at the same moment. At its most basic, the coordination requires visual contact and a brief telepathic countdown. The simultaneous strike deals more damage than either attack alone, as the target cannot defend against both directions at once.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Commands two beasts to perform a coordinated pincer attack. 200% damage if both hit.

name: Lifeshare
subtitle: Beastmaster skill
description: Allows Ren and vitality to flow through the bond, healing either the user or the creature. At its most basic, the healing is moderate — it can close wounds and ease pain, but cannot regenerate lost limbs. The flow of vitality feels like warmth traveling along the bond, and both parties feel a brief drain during the transfer.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Shares HP between the tamer and all bonded beasts. Equalizes health across the pack.

name: Blood Ascension
subtitle: Beastmaster skill
description: Accelerates the growth and potential of a bonded creature through shared experience and Ren exposure. At its most basic, the ascension is slow — the creature's physical abilities improve marginally over weeks of training. The beastmaster must actively channel Ren into the creature during rest periods for the ascension to take effect.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: A bonded beast evolves into a superior form. Permanent stat increase. One evolution per beast.

name: Alpha Will
subtitle: Beastmaster skill
description: Allows the user to maintain bonds with multiple creatures and coordinate all of them with high precision. At its most basic, the alpha can manage two or three bonds simultaneously, issuing orders and sharing senses across all of them. The mental strain is significant, and the alpha must rest frequently to avoid exhaustion.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The tamer’s will suppresses all beasts within 30m, even those bonded to others. Beast obedience check.

name: Hammerborn
subtitle: Smithing skill
description: Shapes metal into functional weapons and armor using a forge, hammer, and basic Veyn reinforcement. At its most basic, the smith can create simple blades and basic chainmail — functional but unremarkable. The Veyn reinforcement adds minor durability and sharpness. The hammer strikes resonate with a faint silver glow as Veyn is channeled into the metal.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Passive: Crafting speed +30%. Weapons crafted have +5% base damage.

name: Star Temper
subtitle: Smithing skill
description: Channels Veyn into metal during forging, giving the finished item minor magical properties such as increased sharpness or durability. At its most basic, the temper adds a single property — a blade that holds its edge longer, or armor that absorbs slightly more impact. The Veyn must be channeled continuously during the final hammer strikes.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Tempers a weapon with starlight, adding +15% Holy Energy damage for 1 hour.

name: Vital Edge
subtitle: Smithing skill
description: Channels the smith's own Ren into a weapon during forging, increasing its striking power. At its most basic, the Ren infusion adds raw physical damage — the weapon hits harder than its weight would suggest. Unlike Veyn infusion, this works through the user's own Vitality rather than ambient energy, and the smith feels drained after the process.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Tempers a weapon with vitality, adding lifesteal (5% of damage dealt) for 1 hour.

name: Crimson Forge
subtitle: Smithing skill
description: Uses angel or demon blood in the forge to create weapons capable of harming high-rank beings. At its most basic, the blood must be from a low-rank source — a Gnash or Lumen. Extremely dangerous if mishandled, as the blood is reactive to Veyn and a mistake can kill the smith. The blood sizzles and sparks when it touches the heated metal.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a temporary forge anywhere. Allows crafting without a stationary forge for 10 minutes.

name: True Edge
subtitle: Smithing skill
description: Instantly judges a weapon's quality, construction, enchantments, and weaknesses through examination. At its most basic, the assessment is surface-level — the smith can tell if a blade is well-balanced and detect obvious flaws, but cannot identify hidden enchantments. The judgment feels like a pulse of Veyn extending from the hands into the weapon.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Ultimate tempering. A weapon gains +25% all damage and ignores 20% of target armor. Lasts 30 minutes.

name: Aegis Craft
subtitle: Smithing skill
description: Specializes in creating armor that absorbs, deflects, or redistributes both physical and magical impacts. At its most basic, the armor can withstand a few strong blows before failing. The smith must layer multiple materials and channel Veyn between each layer to create the redistribution effect.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Crafts a temporary shield from Veyn-infused metal. Blocks 3 hits before shattering.

name: Soulseal
subtitle: Smithing skill
description: Fuses lasting magical effects directly into the metal during the final stage of forging. At its most basic, the seal adds a single enchantment — a blade that glows in the dark, or armor that resists fire. The enchantment is permanent as long as the metal remains intact. The seal appears as a faint runic pattern on the finished item.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Imbues a weapon with the smith’s soul energy. The weapon cannot be dropped or stolen for 24 hours.

name: Reforge
subtitle: Smithing skill
description: Fully repairs damaged weapons and armor, including broken blades and worn enchantments. At its most basic, the reforge can mend cracks, re-sharpen edges, and restore minor enchantments. The smith must heat the item to forging temperature and work the metal back into shape while channeling Veyn.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Repairs any broken weapon or armor to perfect condition. Requires raw materials equal to 50% of original cost.

name: Mythforge
subtitle: Smithing skill
description: Creates multi-layered legendary weapons and armor using materials that lesser smiths cannot work with. At its most basic, the mythforge can handle rare materials like dragon bone or mithril, combining them with Veyn-infused alloys. The resulting items are far superior to standard equipment.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Blacksmith Ultimate - Legendary Crafting

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates legendary weapon from rare materials. 1 hour uninterrupted. Unique properties from materials.

fields.label: Grade
fields.value: S-Grade

name: Bloodalloy
subtitle: Smithing skill
description: Advanced bloodforging that allows mixing blood from different ranks or even angel and demon blood. At its most basic, the alloy creates weapons that can wound or kill beings immune to normal weapons. Extremely powerful and extremely risky — the mixed blood is volatile and can explode if the temperature is wrong.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Tempers a weapon with the smith’s own blood. +30% damage but the smith loses 10% max HP for 1 hour.

name: Sparkbind
subtitle: Enchanter skill
description: Gives ordinary items simple lasting magical properties (glow, sharpness, resistance, etc.). At its most basic, the enchantment is minor — a blade that stays sharp a little longer, a cloak that repels light rain. The process requires direct contact with the item and a focused Veyn pulse. The enchantment fades over months unless reinforced.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Binds a basic rune to an object, granting a minor enchantment (fire damage, light, etc.).

name: Deepbind
subtitle: Enchanter skill
description: Channels Veyn into a finished item to create stronger and more complex magical effects. At its most basic, the bind creates a moderate enchantment — a shield that absorbs a single strong blow, a ring that enhances perception briefly. The Veyn must be precisely measured, as too much causes the item to crack.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Binds a complex rune that requires multiple inscriptions. Grants powerful enchantments.

name: Runeread
subtitle: Enchanter skill
description: Fully reads and understands existing enchantments on an item — their function, strength, and stability. At its most basic, the read identifies the type and power of the enchantment, but cannot determine how to modify it. The reader's eyes glow faintly as they trace the runic patterns with their gaze.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Reads and interprets any rune inscription, even in dead languages. Reveals hidden runes.

name: Unweave
subtitle: Enchanter skill
description: Cleanly removes an enchantment from an item without damaging it. At its most basic, the unweave works on simple enchantments only — complex or layered effects may resist or damage the item. Poor execution can destroy the item. The process involves channeling Veyn into the enchantment and carefully unraveling its structure.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Dismantles an existing rune enchantment, recovering 50% of the materials used.

name: Heighten
subtitle: Enchanter skill
description: Strengthens and stabilizes an existing enchantment, making it more potent or longer-lasting. At its most basic, the heighten adds a marginal boost — perhaps 20% stronger or lasts twice as long. Requires a deep understanding of the original enchantment to avoid destabilizing it.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Amplifies an existing rune’s power by 50% for 10 minutes. Can only heighten one rune at a time.

name: Overlay
subtitle: Enchanter skill
description: Fuses two or more compatible enchantments onto a single item. At its most basic, the overlay can combine two simple effects — a blade that is both sharp and fire-resistant. Incompatible ones can cancel or destroy the item. The enchanter must identify compatible enchantments before attempting the fusion.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Overlays two rune effects on a single object. The runes must be compatible or the overlay fails.

name: Guardseal
subtitle: Enchanter skill
description: Creates defensive enchantments on shields, armor, or objects that absorb or deflect incoming attacks. At its most basic, the seal creates a barrier that can absorb a few hits before failing. The enchantment appears as a glowing runic circle on the item's surface.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a defensive rune that activates when the wielder is attacked. Absorbs one hit.

name: Wrathseal
subtitle: Enchanter skill
description: Places offensive trigger enchantments on weapons that activate on impact (fire, force, etc.). At its most basic, the seal adds a single elemental burst on hit — a burst of flame, a shock of lightning, or a blast of force. The enchantment triggers once per charge and must be replenished.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates an offensive rune that activates on the next attack. Adds 100% bonus damage.

name: Living Rune
subtitle: Enchanter skill
description: Creates complex, adaptive enchantments that can respond to threats or evolve over time. At its most basic, the living rune can detect incoming attacks and adjust its defense accordingly. The rune appears as a shifting, luminous pattern that moves across the item's surface.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a rune that can move between objects. The rune maintains its enchantment indefinitely.

name: Newscript
subtitle: Enchanter skill
description: Allows the user to research and develop entirely new enchantment patterns and effects. At its most basic, the newscript can create minor variations on existing enchantments — a fire enchantment that burns colder, a shield that hardens on impact. The research requires extensive experimentation and documentation.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Invents an entirely new rune. Takes 1 hour of research. The rune can do anything the scribe can imagine.

name: Clear Sight
subtitle: Diviner skill
description: Sees through lies, disguises, and magical concealment, including abilities like Duskveil and Wraithcloth. At its most basic, the sight is instinctive — the Diviner simply knows when something is false. The effect is always active and cannot be turned off, which can be overwhelming in crowded areas.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Sees through illusions, disguises, and invisibility within 30 meters for 10 seconds.

name: Far Sight
subtitle: Diviner skill
description: Glimpses fragmented possible futures as symbols, feelings, or brief flashes. At its most basic, the visions are vague and symbolic — a red door might mean danger, a broken chain might mean freedom. Further and clearer visions cost more Veyn and become less reliable the further ahead the Diviner tries to see.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Projects consciousness up to 500 meters away. Can observe but not interact.

name: Past Echo
subtitle: Diviner skill
description: Views residual past events tied to a specific location or person. At its most basic, the echoes are brief and distorted — like watching a scene through frosted glass. Clarity depends on the strength of the remaining Veyn traces. Strong emotional events leave clearer echoes than mundane ones.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Views events that happened at the current location up to 24 hours ago. Duration: 5 minutes.

name: Liebreak
subtitle: Diviner skill
description: Detects lies and deception in real time through changes in a target's Veyn flow and aura. At its most basic, the detection is subtle — the Diviner feels a slight distortion in the target's aura when they speak falsely. The sensation is brief and can be missed if the Diviner is not focused.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Detects any lie spoken within earshot. The liar is marked with a visible sigil for 10 seconds.

name: Flowsense
subtitle: Diviner skill
description: Senses the presence, density, and nature of Veyn in the surrounding area, including corrupted or holy variants. At its most basic, the sense covers a short radius — perhaps twenty meters. The Diviner can distinguish between raw, corrupted, and holy Veyn, but cannot determine the exact source without moving closer.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Perceives all Veyn flows within 100 meters. Reveals hidden creatures, traps, and conduits.

name: Soulgaze
subtitle: Diviner skill
description: Reads the auras of living beings to reveal emotional state, health, hidden abilities, and magical influence. At its most basic, the gaze shows surface emotions and obvious physical conditions. Deeper readings require sustained focus and may be resisted by strong-willed targets.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Locks eyes with a target and reads their deepest fear. The target is feared for 5 seconds.

name: Deep Vision
subtitle: Diviner skill
description: A prepared ritual form of Far Sight that produces clearer and more detailed visions at the cost of time and materials. At its most basic, the ritual requires a quiet space, incense, and a focal object. The visions are clearer than raw Far Sight but still symbolic and open to interpretation.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Sees up to 72 hours into the future. The vision is fragmentary and metaphorical.

name: Mindlock
subtitle: Diviner skill
description: Protects the user's mind and aura from being read or influenced by other Diviners or mental abilities. At its most basic, the lock blocks casual reading and minor psychic intrusions. Stronger effects may break through, but the lock alerts the Diviner to the attempt.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Blocks all telepathic and precognitive abilities targeting the Seer for 30 minutes.

name: Bond Sight
subtitle: Diviner skill
description: Allows the user to perceive the emotional and magical bonds connecting people. At its most basic, the sight shows faint threads of connection — friendship, rivalry, love, hatred. The threads vary in color and thickness based on the strength and nature of the bond.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Perceives all emotional and contractual bonds of every being within 50 meters.

name: Allsight
subtitle: Diviner skill
description: Temporarily combines multiple divination effects, granting a brief period of heightened all-around awareness. At its most basic, the allsight lasts only a few seconds and causes severe mental fatigue afterward. During the effect, the Diviner perceives truth, past, future, and bonds simultaneously.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Ultimate perception. For 30 seconds, sees everything within 1 kilometer simultaneously. Cannot be blocked.

name: Whitefire
subtitle: Exorcist skill
description: Channels Veyn to cleanse corrupted or unstable Veyn from a person, object, or area. At its most basic, the whitefire removes surface corruption — miasma stains, minor curses, tainted objects. The fire appears as a pale, cold flame that burns away corruption without harming the living.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Summons purifying white fire that burns corrupted beings. Deals 200% Holy Energy damage.

name: Fallen Bind
subtitle: Exorcist skill
description: Specialized binding techniques used to suppress and contain the unstable power of Fallen Angels. At its most basic, the bind creates Veyn chains that restrain a Fallen Angel's physical form. The chains glow with purified Veyn and tighten if the target struggles.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Binds a Fallen Angel or corrupted being for 10 seconds. The bound entity cannot use Veyn.

name: Miasma Break
subtitle: Exorcist skill
description: Extracts and neutralizes demonic miasma from living beings, places, or objects. At its most basic, the extraction is painful for the target — the miasma clings to the body and must be pulled out strand by strand. The process often causes the target to scream as the corruption is torn free.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Dispels all Corrupted Veyn effects within 15 meters. Cleanses allies and damages enemies.

name: Stillflow
subtitle: Exorcist skill
description: Calms chaotic or fluctuating Veyn, preventing it from becoming corrupted or dangerously unstable. At its most basic, the stillflow stabilizes a small area — perhaps a room or a patch of ground. The effect is temporary and must be maintained with ongoing Veyn channeling.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Stops all Veyn movement in a 10-meter area for 5 seconds. No one can use Veyn skills inside.

name: Expulsion Rite
subtitle: Exorcist skill
description: A formal ritual that forces out deep possession, curses, or heavy contamination. At its most basic, the rite requires a ritual circle, specific components, and several hours of focused chanting. The more entrenched the corruption, the longer and more dangerous the ritual becomes.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Performs a rite that forces a possessing entity out of a host. 100% success on low-rank entities.

name: Holy Bastion
subtitle: Exorcist skill
description: Creates a barrier of purified Veyn that is especially effective against demons, undead, and miasma. At its most basic, the bastion blocks physical attacks and weakens corrupted beings who touch it. The barrier appears as a wall of pale, cold light.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a fortress of Holy Energy. Allies inside are healed and protected for 15 seconds.

name: Purge Strike
subtitle: Exorcist skill
description: Channels purified Veyn into a physical attack that deals heavy extra damage to corrupted beings. At its most basic, the strike is a single powerful blow that disrupts the target's corrupted Veyn on contact. The more corrupted the target, the more effective the strike becomes.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: A weapon attack infused with purifying energy. Deals 250% damage to corrupted beings.

name: Mass Cleanse
subtitle: Exorcist skill
description: Allows the purification of multiple targets or a wide area at once. At its most basic, the cleanse covers a small group — perhaps five or ten people. Requires significant Veyn and concentration, and the effect is weaker than individual purification.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Removes all negative status effects from all allies within 20 meters.

name: Spirit Drive
subtitle: Exorcist skill
description: Forces powerful residual spirits or wills to disperse or leave an area. At its most basic, the drive weakens the spirit's hold and forces it to retreat temporarily. The spirit may return if the underlying cause is not addressed.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Forces a spirit or ghost to leave the material plane. 80% success rate.

name: Eternal Seal
subtitle: Exorcist skill
description: Places a powerful, lasting suppression on extreme corruption or dangerous entities, locking their power away. At its most basic, the seal can contain moderate corruption for decades. The seal appears as a glowing runic circle that burns into the target's body or the surrounding area.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Seals a corrupted being or object permanently. Requires 10 seconds of channeling. Cannot be broken.

name: Balance
subtitle: Broker skill
description: Drafts, reads, and balances contracts so that terms are clear, enforceable, and as fair as possible. At its most basic, the Broker can create simple trade agreements with clear penalties for breach. The contract is magically binding once signed, but the terms must be reasonable.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Maintains perfect composure in negotiations. +30% success rate on all contract skills.

name: Bindword
subtitle: Broker skill
description: Magically triggers the penalties written into a signed contract when a party breaks the terms. At its most basic, the enforcement is automatic — the moment a breach is detected, the penalty activates. The Broker must be within range to witness the breach.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a simple verbal contract. The contract is magically binding. Breaking it deals minor damage.

name: Loophole
subtitle: Broker skill
description: Detects hidden clauses, loopholes, and magical bindings inside a contract. At its most basic, the detection identifies obvious traps and unfair terms. Hidden or magically concealed clauses require deeper examination.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Finds a loophole in an existing contract, allowing the Broker to escape or modify its terms.

name: Contract Break
subtitle: Broker skill
description: Forcibly dissolves a signed contract. At its most basic, the break carries a high risk of backlash to both parties and the Broker. The backlash manifests as a surge of painful Veyn that can injure or incapacitate.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Breaks any contract within 30 meters. Both parties take backlash damage equal to 10% max HP.

name: Silver Tongue
subtitle: Broker skill
description: Expert persuasion and negotiation used to find acceptable terms between hostile or difficult parties. At its most basic, the Broker can calm tensions and find minor compromises. The skill relies on reading body language and Veyn fluctuations as much as words.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: For 5 minutes, everything the Broker says sounds persuasive. +50% success rate on negotiations.

name: Falsesense
subtitle: Broker skill
description: Senses dishonesty during negotiations through body language, voice, and small Veyn fluctuations. At its most basic, the sense detects obvious lies and evasions. Subtle deception or magically enhanced lying may slip through.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Detects if a contract has hidden clauses, traps, or unintended consequences.

name: Backlash Guard
subtitle: Broker skill
description: Creates a protective ward that guards the Broker against magical backlash from contracts and hostile parties. At its most basic, the ward absorbs a single instance of backlash before needing to be renewed. The ward appears as a faint glow around the Broker's hands.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Reduces contract-breaking backlash damage by 50%. Also reduces self-damage from broken contracts.

name: Web
subtitle: Broker skill
description: Maintains a web of contacts, informants, and fellow Brokers across different areas and realms. At its most basic, the web provides basic information and local contacts in major cities. Expanding the web requires time and trust-building.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a network of informants. Every 10 minutes, receives a random piece of useful intelligence.

name: Pressure
subtitle: Broker skill
description: Turns small pieces of information or minor advantages into strong negotiating positions. At its most basic, the Broker can leverage a single piece of leverage into a favorable term. The skill requires quick thinking and intimate knowledge of the other party's fears.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Applies psychological pressure to a target during negotiation. -30% to their resistance.

name: Ironword
subtitle: Broker skill
description: Creates high-stakes contracts that are extremely difficult to break and carry severe consequences. At its most basic, the ironword binds the signer to terms that cannot be escaped by any known means. The penalty for breaking an ironword is catastrophic — often death or permanent loss of power.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates an unbreakable contract. Neither party can break it without dying. Used for high-stakes deals.

name: Light Mend
subtitle: Saintess skill
description: Channels Holy Energy to heal wounds and purge corruption-related ailments more effectively than ordinary healing. At its most basic, the mend closes minor wounds and eases pain. The light is warm and gentle, and the patient feels a soothing heat spread through the affected area.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Heals a target for 20% of max HP over 5 seconds. Can be cast while moving.

name: Radiant Aegis
subtitle: Saintess skill
description: Creates a barrier of Holy Energy that is especially strong against demonic and corrupted attacks. At its most basic, the aegis blocks a single attack before fading. The barrier appears as a disc of golden light that burns corrupted beings on contact.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a shield of light that absorbs damage equal to 50% of the Cleric’s max Veyn.

name: Holy Purge
subtitle: Saintess skill
description: Purifies curses, miasma, and corruption from a target or area with focused Holy Energy. At its most basic, the purge removes surface-level contamination — a cursed object, a miasma stain, a minor hex. The process causes the corruption to dissolve into golden sparks.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Removes one negative status effect from a target. Also deals minor damage to corrupted beings.

name: Burning Guard
subtitle: Saintess skill
description: Forms a radiant shield that blocks attacks and burns corrupted beings on contact. At its most basic, the guard absorbs a few hits and deals minor burn damage to undead or demons who touch it. The shield dims as it absorbs damage.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a shield that reflects 30% of damage taken back to the attacker for 10 seconds.

name: Judgment Blow
subtitle: Saintess skill
description: Infuses a melee attack with Holy Energy that deals heavy extra damage to undead and demons. At its most basic, the blow is a single powerful strike that disrupts the target's unholy essence. The attack leaves a lingering burn of purified light on the target.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: A weapon strike empowered by divine judgment. Deals 200% damage to evil-aligned targets.

name: Blessing
subtitle: Saintess skill
description: Temporarily boosts an ally's resistance to corruption and increases their Veyn recovery. At its most basic, the blessing lasts a few minutes and provides a marginal improvement. The blessed ally glows faintly with golden light for the duration.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Blesses an ally, granting +15% all stats for 30 seconds. Can bless up to 3 targets.

name: Sacred Ground
subtitle: Saintess skill
description: Places a lasting holy zone that repels corrupted beings and slowly purifies the area. At its most basic, the zone covers a small area and lasts only a short time. Undead and demons who enter the zone take burn damage and are weakened.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Consecrates a 10-meter area for 30 seconds. Allies inside heal 3% HP/sec. Enemies take minor damage.

name: Reveal Light
subtitle: Saintess skill
description: Emits cleansing light that reveals hidden beings, burns undead, and weakens demonic power. At its most basic, the light covers a moderate area and forces invisible or concealed beings to become visible. Undead and demons are slowed and weakened by the light.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Reveals all hidden, invisible, or disguised beings within 30 meters.

name: Holy Precision
subtitle: Saintess skill
description: Allows precise and selective use of Holy Energy for complex healing and combat applications. At its most basic, the precision allows the Saintess to target specific wounds or corruption without affecting surrounding tissue. The control requires intense concentration.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Grants perfect accuracy for 10 seconds. All attacks cannot miss.

name: Divine Act
subtitle: Saintess skill
description: Advanced holy techniques that can produce effects beyond normal limits of the class. At its most basic, the divine act can achieve seemingly impossible feats — curing incurable diseases, banishing powerful demons, or creating barriers that last for days. The cost is severe physical and spiritual exhaustion.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Ultimate ability. The Cleric performs a miracle: fully heals all allies within 20 meters and revives any dead allies with 50% HP. 10-minute cooldown.

name: Soft Heal
subtitle: Clergy skill
description: Channels Veyn to heal minor wounds, cuts, bruises, and light burns. At its most basic, the healing is gentle and slow — the wound closes over several seconds, and the patient feels warmth spreading through the area. The Veyn消耗 is minimal.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Heals a target for 15% of max HP instantly. Low Veyn cost.

name: Deep Heal
subtitle: Clergy skill
description: Heals serious injuries such as broken bones, deep cuts, and internal damage. Takes more time and Veyn than basic healing. At its most basic, the deep heal can mend a broken arm or close a deep laceration, but the process takes minutes and drains the healer significantly.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Heals a target for 40% of max HP over 8 seconds. Can be interrupted.

name: Recovery Rite
subtitle: Clergy skill
description: A prepared healing ritual used for wounds too severe for direct methods. Takes time but can save lives. At its most basic, the rite requires a quiet space, bandages, and focused Veyn channeling over several hours. The patient must remain still throughout.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Performs a healing ritual that restores 60% of target’s max HP over 15 seconds. Requires standing still.

name: Protect Field
subtitle: Clergy skill
description: Creates a barrier that absorbs damage directed at wounded allies, giving the healer time to work. At its most basic, the field absorbs a few hits before failing. The barrier appears as a translucent dome of pale light over the patient.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a healing field that restores 2% HP per second to all allies within 10 meters for 20 seconds.

name: Lifebloom
subtitle: Clergy skill
description: Places a lasting effect on an ally that accelerates their natural healing over several hours. At its most basic, the lifebloom speeds recovery by a small margin — a wound that would take days heals in half the time. The effect persists through mild activity.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Plants a healing seed on a target. When the target drops below 30% HP, the seed blooms and heals 50% HP instantly.

name: Healing Ground
subtitle: Clergy skill
description: Creates a zone that continuously heals anyone inside it. At its most basic, the zone covers a small area and provides slow, passive healing. Useful for field treatment areas where multiple wounded need attention.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Consecrates the ground in a 15-meter radius. All allies standing on it regenerate 4% HP per second.

name: Calm Light
subtitle: Clergy skill
description: Emits a gentle light that eases pain, calms the mind, and mildly speeds recovery in those nearby. At its most basic, the light covers a moderate radius and provides marginal relief. The effect is passive and does not require active concentration.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Reduces the target’s pain and slows their vital signs. Target takes 20% less damage for 15 seconds.

name: Life Restore
subtitle: Clergy skill
description: Advanced healing capable of restoring lost limbs (with rare components) and pulling someone back from the edge of death. At its most basic, the restore can mend even catastrophic injuries if the patient is not already dead. Requires rare reagents and hours of work.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Restores a target to their optimal health state — removes all injuries, diseases, and poisons.

name: Special Cure
subtitle: Clergy skill
description: Develops and applies specialized treatments for rare conditions and unique injuries. At its most basic, the cure can address conditions that standard healing cannot — magical diseases, cursed wounds, Veyn corruption. Each case requires research and custom formulation.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Cures any known disease or curse. If the ailment is unknown, the Medic must first diagnose it.

name: Healer's Hand
subtitle: Clergy skill
description: Allows the user to effectively train others in healing techniques, helping maintain the number of capable healers. At its most basic, the teacher can convey basic healing methods to students. The skill includes the ability to diagnose student errors and correct them.

fields.label: Type
fields.value: Medic Ultimate - Passive Combat Healing

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Touch becomes healing conduit. Melee heals 5% of damage dealt. Cannot turn off. Requires physical contact.

fields.label: Cooldown
fields.value: None (passive)

fields.label: Grade
fields.value: S-Grade

name: Spell Arrow
subtitle: Archer skill
description: Enchants an arrow with Veyn before firing, adding elemental or force effects that activate on impact. At its most basic, the enchantment adds a single elemental burst — fire, ice, or force. The arrow carries the enchantment until impact, and the effect is modest.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Fires an arrow infused with Veyn. The arrow deals magical damage on impact. Range: 100m.

name: Sunder Arrow
subtitle: Archer skill
description: Focuses Veyn into the arrowhead so it can punch through armor, shields, and barriers. At its most basic, the sunder can penetrate light armor and wooden shields. Heavier protection may resist or slow the arrow.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Fires an arrow that shatters armor on impact. Target’s armor is reduced by 30% for 10 seconds.

name: Burst Arrow
subtitle: Archer skill
description: Creates arrows that detonate on impact, damaging everything in a small radius. At its most basic, the burst is small — enough to wound nearby enemies but not lethal to anyone beyond the immediate blast zone. The explosion scatters residual Veyn.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Fires an explosive arrow that deals AoE damage in a 5m radius.

name: Homing Bolt
subtitle: Archer skill
description: Enchants an arrow so it actively adjusts its path mid-flight to follow a designated target. At its most basic, the homing is weak — the arrow curves gently toward the target and can be dodged by quick movement. The tracking lasts only a few seconds.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Fires a Veyn-guided arrow that tracks the target. Cannot be dodged by normal movement.

name: Skyfall
subtitle: Archer skill
description: Launches a volley of enchanted arrows into the air to rain down over a wide area. At its most basic, the skyfall covers a moderate area and each arrow carries a basic enchantment. The arrows fall at steep angles, making them difficult to block.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Rains arrows from above in a 10-meter area. 20 arrows deal 50% weapon damage each.

name: Quiver Wall
subtitle: Archer skill
description: Plants arrows in the ground to form a temporary Veyn barrier that blocks incoming attacks. At its most basic, the wall covers a short stretch and absorbs a few hits. The arrows glow with Veyn and serve as anchor points for the barrier.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Fires a rapid volley of 10 arrows in 2 seconds. Each deals 80% weapon damage.

name: Final Arrow
subtitle: Archer skill
description: A single, fully charged arrow fired with extreme speed and penetrating power. At its most basic, the final arrow carries the full force of the archer's Veyn and can punch through heavy armor. The shot leaves the archer temporarily drained.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Channels all remaining Veyn into a single devastating arrow. Deals 500% weapon damage. Uses all Veyn.

name: Grace Arrow
subtitle: Archer skill
description: Enchants an arrow with healing Veyn, allowing the archer to restore allies from a distance. At its most basic, the grace arrow can close minor wounds on impact. The arrow must strike the target gently — firing too hard negates the healing effect.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Fires an arrow that heals the first ally it hits for 30% of their max HP.

name: Perfect Shot
subtitle: Archer skill
description: Allows complex multi-effect enchantments on arrows and extreme-range precision shooting. At its most basic, the perfect shot combines two effects on a single arrow — fire and piercing, or ice and homing. The precision allows hits at ranges beyond normal sight.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Next arrow is guaranteed to hit a vital point. Deals 300% weapon damage and applies a 5-second stun.

name: Arrowcraft
subtitle: Archer skill
description: Develops entirely new forms of magical ammunition and arrow techniques. At its most basic, the arrowcraft can create arrows with unique properties — arrows that split into multiple projectiles, arrows that create barriers on impact, or arrows that drain Veyn from targets.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Can craft arrows from any material. Magical arrows deal +20% damage.

name: Golden Strike
subtitle: Paladin skill
description: Channels golden Ren into a powerful melee attack that burns corrupted beings and heals nearby allies. At its most basic, the strike is a single radiant blow that deals moderate damage to corruption and minor healing to allies. The golden energy flares briefly on impact.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: A weapon attack infused with golden light. Deals 200% damage and heals the Knight for 10% of damage dealt.

name: Dawn Shield
subtitle: Paladin skill
description: Creates a radiant barrier that blocks attacks and burns corrupted beings on contact. At its most basic, the shield absorbs a few hits and deals minor burn damage to undead or demons. The barrier appears as a disc of golden light.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a golden shield that absorbs damage equal to 100% of the Knight’s max HP. Lasts 15 seconds.

name: Auric Mend
subtitle: Paladin skill
description: Heals allies with golden Ren while purifying corruption inside the wounds. At its most basic, the mend closes wounds and removes minor corruption. The golden energy spreads through the patient's body like warm light.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Heals an ally for 25% of their max HP. The Knight takes 5% of their own HP as cost.

name: Courage Aura
subtitle: Paladin skill
description: Strengthens nearby allies against fear, charm, and morale-breaking effects. At its most basic, the aura provides a marginal boost to mental resistance. Allies near the Paladin feel a surge of confidence and determination.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: All allies within 15 meters gain +20% attack power and immunity to fear for 20 seconds.

name: Final Judgment
subtitle: Paladin skill
description: A massive single-target strike of pure golden Ren that deals heavy damage to corrupted and undead beings. At its most basic, the judgment is a single devastating blow that can incapacitate a low-rank corrupted being. The golden energy explodes on impact.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The Knight channels divine judgment into a single attack. Deals 400% damage to the strongest enemy in range.

name: Sacred Touch
subtitle: Paladin skill
description: Direct-contact healing that restores injuries and purifies corruption at the same time. At its most basic, the touch can mend moderate wounds and remove surface corruption. The healer must maintain physical contact throughout the process.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The Knight’s touch purifies corruption. Removes one negative magical effect and heals 10% HP.

name: Holy Ground
subtitle: Paladin skill
description: Blesses an area so that it heals allies and damages corrupted beings standing on it. At its most basic, the ground covers a small area and provides passive healing to allies while burning undead. The effect lasts as long as the Paladin maintains concentration.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Consecrates a 10-meter area. Allies inside gain +15% all stats. Enemies take Holy Energy damage.

name: Guardian Seal
subtitle: Paladin skill
description: Places an automatic protective ward on an ally that activates when they are attacked. At its most basic, the seal absorbs a single hit and then shatters. The ward appears as a faint golden glow on the ally's shoulder.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a seal that protects one ally. The sealed ally cannot drop below 1 HP for 10 seconds.

name: Oath Power
subtitle: Paladin skill
description: Temporarily increases the Paladin's power when their allies are in serious danger. At its most basic, the power boost is moderate — increased strength, speed, and Ren output for a short duration. The boost fades once the danger passes.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The Knight declares an oath. While the oath is active, all stats are +25%. Breaking the oath deals 50% self-damage.

name: Radiant Champion
subtitle: Paladin skill
description: A full temporary empowerment that turns the Paladin into a beacon of golden light, greatly enhancing all abilities. At its most basic, the champion form lasts only a minute and leaves the Paladin exhausted afterward. During the form, all paladin abilities are doubled in power.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Ultimate form. The Knight becomes a being of pure golden light for 30 seconds. +50% all stats, immunity to damage, all attacks deal Holy Energy damage.

name: Awaken
subtitle: Grimtender skill
description: Channels Veyn into the remains of a fallen creature, reanimating it as an undead servant under the user's control. At its most basic, the awakened creature retains basic physical abilities but moves stiffly and slowly. The Veyn cost is moderate.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Raises a single undead minion from a corpse. The minion has 50% of the original’s stats.

name: Dead Order
subtitle: Grimtender skill
description: Issues precise combat orders to one or more reanimated servants. At its most basic, the orders are simple — attack, defend, move to position. The undead respond slowly but obey without question.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Commands all undead minions to perform a coordinated attack. +20% damage per minion.

name: Bone Guard
subtitle: Grimtender skill
description: Commands reanimated bodies to intercept attacks, using them as disposable shields. At its most basic, the guard takes full damage from the attack and may be destroyed. The Grimtender can reassemble destroyed undead later.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a shield of bone that absorbs damage equal to 80% of the Necromancer’s max HP.

name: Grave Drain
subtitle: Grimtender skill
description: Siphons residual Veyn from nearby corpses and remains to restore the user's own reserves. At its most basic, the drain extracts a small amount of Veyn from each corpse. The more powerful the remains, the more Veyn is gained.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Drains life from a corpse, healing the Necromancer for 30% of their max HP.

name: Death Pulse
subtitle: Grimtender skill
description: Releases a wave of necrotic energy that weakens living targets and strengthens undead ones. At its most basic, the pulse covers a small area and causes minor weakness in living targets while slightly boosting undead movement speed.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Releases a pulse of death energy in a 10-meter radius. Deals Corrupted Veyn damage and slows enemies.

name: Bone Legion
subtitle: Grimtender skill
description: Reanimates a large number of remains at once, creating a group of undead servants. At its most basic, the legion can raise a dozen weak skeletons simultaneously. The more remains available, the larger the legion.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Raises 10 undead minions from nearby corpses. Minions last 60 seconds.

name: Bone Spear
subtitle: Grimtender skill
description: Shapes bone into a projectile and launches it, carrying necrotic Veyn that damages on impact. At its most basic, the spear is a single bone shard that can wound a target. The necrotic Veyn causes lingering damage.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Fires a spear of compressed bone that deals 200% weapon damage and pierces through targets.

name: Soul Bind
subtitle: Grimtender skill
description: Binds residual spirit more tightly to remains, creating stronger and more intelligent undead. At its most basic, the bind creates an undead that retains some of its former knowledge and can follow complex commands.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Binds a spirit to the Necromancer’s will. The spirit becomes a permanent minion with full stats.

name: Grave Lord
subtitle: Grimtender skill
description: Allows permanent high-quality undead and large-scale simultaneous control. At its most basic, the lord can maintain a dozen powerful undead indefinitely and coordinate them in battle. The mental strain is significant.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The Necromancer’s minions gain +50% all stats and become immune to holy damage for 30 seconds.

name: Soul Take
subtitle: Grimtender skill
description: Extracts and stores residual essence from the newly dead for later use in powerful reanimation. At its most basic, the take preserves the spirit's essence for weeks, allowing the Grimtender to create elite undead later.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Ultimate. Steals the soul of a dying enemy, preventing resurrection and adding the soul to the Necromancer’s collection.

name: Wide Cut
subtitle: Bladesinger skill
description: A rapid sweeping sword strike that can hit multiple targets in one motion. At its most basic, the cleave can strike two or three enemies in a line. The blade moves so fast it leaves a faint crimson trail in the air.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: A sweeping attack that hits all enemies within 8 meters. Deals 130% weapon damage.

name: Blood Edge
subtitle: Bladesinger skill
description: Coats the blade in concentrated Ren, greatly increasing its cutting power. At its most basic, the Ren edge lasts only a few strikes before fading. The coated blade can cut through materials that would normally resist steel.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Empowers the blade with the dancer’s blood. +30% damage but costs 5% max HP per hit for 10 seconds.

name: Blade Dance
subtitle: Bladesinger skill
description: Uses rapid, precise blade movements to deflect incoming attacks with minimal effort. At its most basic, the dance can redirect one or two attacks before the user must reset. The movements are fluid and instinctive.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: A flurry of 8 attacks in 3 seconds. Each deals 80% weapon damage. Can target multiple enemies.

name: Return Cut
subtitle: Bladesinger skill
description: Responds to an incoming attack with an immediate and precise counter-strike. At its most basic, the counter is a single reactive slash that exploits the attacker's opening. The more committed the attack, the more devastating the return.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Throws the blade, which returns like a boomerang. Deals 150% damage on both the throw and return.

name: Wind Step
subtitle: Bladesinger skill
description: Uses Ren to propel the user forward in a burst of speed, closing distance instantly. At its most basic, the step covers a short distance and creates a small gust of wind. The movement is nearly instantaneous.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: A rapid dash that leaves a damaging wind trail. Deals 100% weapon damage to enemies in the path.

name: Ghost Cut
subtitle: Bladesinger skill
description: Strikes from an unexpected angle by masking the blade's movement with Ren. At its most basic, the cut obscures the blade's approach for a split second, making it difficult to defend. The strike seems to come from nowhere.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The dancer becomes invisible for 2 seconds, then delivers a surprise attack for 250% weapon damage.

name: Storm of Blades
subtitle: Bladesinger skill
description: Unleashes a rapid series of Ren-enhanced slashes that create a whirlwind of attacks. At its most basic, the storm delivers three or four slashes in rapid succession. Each slash carries Ren and the combined force shreds through defenses.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The blade spins autonomously for 5 seconds, attacking all nearby enemies for 60% weapon damage per second.

name: Perfect Form
subtitle: Bladesinger skill
description: Passively enhances balance, coordination, and reaction speed, allowing the user to maintain form even while wounded. At its most basic, the form provides a moderate boost to agility and reaction time. The effect is always active.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The dancer enters a state of perfect technique. All attacks are critical hits for 10 seconds.

name: Sword Song
subtitle: Bladesinger skill
description: Enters a focused state where Ren flows rhythmically through the body, enhancing all physical and blade techniques. At its most basic, the song boosts all physical abilities by a significant margin. The Ren flows in visible crimson patterns along the body.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The blade resonates with a musical frequency. All allies within 15 meters gain +15% attack speed.

name: Flawless Edge
subtitle: Bladesinger skill
description: The user executes every movement with optimal efficiency and zero wasted motion. At its most basic, the edge provides a major boost to all combat abilities — perfect strikes, perfect defense, perfect timing. The blade becomes an extension of the soul.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The blade becomes temporarily unbreakable. Cannot be disarmed, and attacks ignore parry for 15 seconds.

name: Blood Rage
subtitle: Berserker skill
description: Enters a controlled rage that greatly increases physical strength and pain tolerance while reducing precision. At its most basic, the rage boosts strength by about 50% and numbs pain. The user's eyes glow red and their muscles visibly tense.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Enters a rage that increases damage by 40% but reduces defense by 25%. Lasts 15 seconds.

name: Battle Roar
subtitle: Berserker skill
description: Releases a Ren-infused shout that staggers nearby enemies and weakens their resolve. At its most basic, the roar causes momentary disorientation and fear in weaker opponents. The sound carries a visible shockwave of crimson energy.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: A devastating roar that stuns all enemies within 10 meters for 3 seconds.

name: Killing Blow
subtitle: Berserker skill
description: Channels a massive burst of Ren into a single attack for extreme damage, leaving the user temporarily drained. At its most basic, the blow deals devastating damage to a single target but leaves the user vulnerable afterward.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: A powerful overhead strike that deals 300% weapon damage. If the target is below 30% HP, damage doubles.

name: All-In
subtitle: Berserker skill
description: Abandons defense for one devastating attack that leaves the user completely open afterward. At its most basic, the attack deals catastrophic damage to a single target but removes all defensive capability for a short time.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The Berserker attacks with everything. Deals 500% weapon damage but the Berserker takes 20% self-damage.

name: Never Fall
subtitle: Berserker skill
description: When health falls critically low, Ren automatically surges to keep the user fighting through wounds that would stop others. At its most basic, the surge provides a brief window of enhanced fighting ability before the exhaustion hits.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: When the Berserker drops below 20% HP, they automatically enter Blood Rage for 10 seconds. Once per fight.

name: Mad Rampage
subtitle: Berserker skill
description: Fully unleashes rage, massively increasing strength and speed but removing the ability to distinguish friend from foe. At its most basic, the rampage doubles all physical abilities but the user attacks anything nearby.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The Berserker attacks randomly for 5 seconds, hitting all enemies in range for 100% weapon damage each. Cannot be controlled.

name: Rage Burst
subtitle: Berserker skill
description: Explodes all accumulated Ren outward, damaging and knocking back everything nearby. At its most basic, the burst covers a small radius and deals moderate damage. The force can break grapples and shatter barriers.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Releases stored rage energy in an AoE explosion. Damage scales with how much damage the Berserker has taken.

name: Bone Break
subtitle: Berserker skill
description: A targeted strike meant to disable a specific body part, such as shattering a bone or tearing a tendon. At its most basic, the strike can break a single bone or tear a single muscle group. The damage is permanent without healing.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: A devastating attack that shatters the target’s armor and deals 200% weapon damage.

name: Final Rage
subtitle: Berserker skill
description: A final, suicidal burst of power used when death is certain, dealing catastrophic damage to everything nearby including the user. At its most basic, the rage creates a massive explosion of Ren that destroys everything in the immediate area.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Ultimate. The Berserker enters an unstoppable rage for 10 seconds. +80% damage, immune to death (stays at 1 HP). Collapses afterward for 30 seconds.

name: War Cry
subtitle: Berserker skill
description: A roar so powerful it distorts the air, shatters weak structures, and empowers nearby allies while crushing enemy morale. At its most basic, the cry boosts allied fighting ability and staggers enemies. The sound is felt as much as heard.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Inspires all allies within 20 meters. +10% attack power for 20 seconds. Stacks with other buffs.

name: Iron Skin
subtitle: Sentinel skill
description: Coats armor and shield in concentrated Ren, greatly increasing their durability. At its most basic, the Ren reinforcement adds a moderate boost to armor value. The armor glows faintly with crimson energy when struck.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Hardens the Guardian’s skin, reducing all damage taken by 30% for 15 seconds.

name: Stone Wall
subtitle: Sentinel skill
description: Creates a solid barrier of Ren in a chosen direction to block incoming attacks. At its most basic, the wall covers a short stretch and absorbs a few hits. The barrier appears as a translucent crimson wall.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a wall of stone that blocks movement and projectiles for 10 seconds.

name: Rooted Stance
subtitle: Sentinel skill
description: The user plants their feet and becomes nearly immovable, taking reduced damage and resisting knockback. At its most basic, the stance provides a moderate damage reduction and prevents being pushed back. The user's feet seem to meld with the ground.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The Guardian roots to the ground. Cannot move but gains +50% damage reduction and cannot be knocked back.

name: Challenge
subtitle: Sentinel skill
description: Projects a challenge that forces enemies to focus their attacks on the Sentinel instead of allies. At its most basic, the challenge works on weaker-willed opponents and lasts only a few seconds. The Sentinel glows with a faint crimson aura.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Taunts all enemies within 20 meters, forcing them to attack the Guardian for 8 seconds.

name: Stand Firm
subtitle: Sentinel skill
description: Allows the user to continue functioning even under severe injury by reinforcing the body with Ren. At its most basic, the Ren reinforcement numbs pain and keeps the body moving despite wounds. The effect is passive and always active.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: The Guardian absorbs all damage intended for allies within 10 meters for 5 seconds.

name: Shield Crash
subtitle: Sentinel skill
description: Slams the shield into an opponent with Ren-enhanced force, dealing damage and potentially stunning them. At its most basic, the crash deals moderate bludgeoning damage and may daze the target for a moment.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Slams the shield into a target, dealing 150% weapon damage and stunning for 3 seconds.

name: Shared Guard
subtitle: Sentinel skill
description: Extends the Sentinel's protective effect to nearby allies, reducing the damage they take. At its most basic, the guard absorbs a portion of damage that would otherwise hit allies. The effect covers a small radius.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Shares damage taken with all allies within 15 meters. Each ally absorbs 10% of the damage.

name: Protect Ally
subtitle: Sentinel skill
description: Designates an ally to protect. The Sentinel automatically intercepts attacks aimed at that ally. At its most basic, the Sentinel reacts quickly to intercept but takes full damage from the attack.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Intercepts an attack aimed at an ally. Takes the damage and reduces it by 30%.

name: Final Stand
subtitle: Sentinel skill
description: Once per battle, when the user would fall, a reserve of Ren keeps them alive at 1 health for a short time. At its most basic, the stand lasts only a few seconds — enough to deliver one final attack or retreat.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: When the Guardian drops below 15% HP, they become immovable for 10 seconds. Cannot be moved, stunned, or killed.

name: Unbreakable
subtitle: Sentinel skill
description: The user becomes a wide-area defensive bastion, taking drastically reduced damage and protecting a large zone around them. At its most basic, the bastion reduces incoming damage by a massive margin and covers a significant area.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Ultimate. The Guardian becomes completely immune to all damage for 5 seconds. Cannot attack during this time.

name: Power Bolt
subtitle: Ren Archer skill
description: Coats an arrow in Ren before firing, increasing its force and penetration. At its most basic, the Ren coating adds moderate damage and allows the arrow to pierce light armor. The arrow glows faintly crimson in flight.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Fires a heavily loaded bolt that deals 200% weapon damage and penetrates one target.

name: Heavy Draw
subtitle: Ren Archer skill
description: Charges an arrow with maximum Ren and fires it at extreme speed and power. At its most basic, the heavy draw deals devastating damage to a single target but drains significant Ren. The arrow leaves a crimson trail.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Takes 2 seconds to draw the crossbow fully. The next shot deals 300% weapon damage.

name: Quick Volley
subtitle: Ren Archer skill
description: Fires a quick succession of Ren-enhanced arrows without pausing between shots. At its most basic, the volley fires three or four arrows in rapid succession. Each arrow carries enough Ren to wound.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Fires 3 bolts in rapid succession. Each deals 80% weapon damage.

name: Armor Break
subtitle: Ren Archer skill
description: Concentrates Ren into the arrowhead so it can punch through heavy armor and shields. At its most basic, the break can penetrate medium armor and wooden shields. Heavier protection may resist.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Fires a bolt that reduces the target’s armor by 25% for 10 seconds.

name: Gale Step
subtitle: Ren Archer skill
description: Uses Ren to move quickly and silently, allowing rapid repositioning between shots. At its most basic, the step covers a short distance and is nearly silent. The movement leaves no trace.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: A quick dash that repositions the Crossbowman. Can be used while reloading.

name: Far Shot
subtitle: Ren Archer skill
description: Takes careful aim and fires a single arrow with perfect precision at extreme range. At its most basic, the far shot can hit targets beyond normal sight range. The Ren coating ensures the arrow maintains its trajectory.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Doubles the range of the next shot. The shot deals +20% damage at maximum range.

name: Arrow Storm
subtitle: Ren Archer skill
description: Fires a dense cloud of Ren-coated arrows that blankets an area. At its most basic, the storm covers a moderate area and each arrow carries enough force to wound. The sheer volume makes it difficult to dodge.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Fires a rain of bolts in a 10-meter area. 15 bolts deal 40% weapon damage each.

name: Sidestep
subtitle: Ren Archer skill
description: A Ren-enhanced dodge that allows the user to avoid attacks while staying ready to fire. At its most basic, the sidestep provides a quick lateral movement that can evade a single attack. The user remains in firing stance.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: A quick dodge that evades the next attack. Has a 3-second internal cooldown.

name: Sharp Eye
subtitle: Ren Archer skill
description: Passively enhances vision, target tracking, and distance judgment. At its most basic, the eye provides a moderate boost to visual acuity and target acquisition. The effect is always active.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Passive: Critical hit chance +15%. Critical hits deal 150% damage.

name: Arrow Master
subtitle: Ren Archer skill
description: Allows perfect accuracy while moving and the creation of hovering arrow constructs that can fire on command. At its most basic, the master can create two or three hovering arrows that fire independently. The accuracy is flawless.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: All crossbow attacks gain +10% damage and +10% range permanently.

name: Shadow Move
subtitle: Veilrunner skill
description: Uses Ren to move silently and quickly through dim light and shadows, becoming hard to track. At its most basic, the move reduces sound and allows passage through shadows without detection. The user appears as a fleeting dark shape.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Teleports 10 meters through shadows. Cannot be seen during the teleport.

name: No Sound
subtitle: Veilrunner skill
description: Completely suppresses all sound from the user's movements, including footsteps and clothing. At its most basic, the silence is absolute — the user makes no noise whatsoever. The effect is passive and always active.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Passive: Movement is completely silent. Cannot be detected by sound-based abilities.

name: Death from Behind
subtitle: Veilrunner skill
description: A high-damage precision strike delivered from behind, targeting vital points. At its most basic, the backstab deals massive damage and may be lethal on a clean hit. The strike targets the spine, neck, or kidneys.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Attacks from behind deal +50% damage. This bonus applies to all attacks, not just stealth.

name: Smoke Screen
subtitle: Veilrunner skill
description: Creates a cloud of smoke or dust that breaks line of sight and allows repositioning or escape. At its most basic, the screen covers a small area and lasts a few seconds. The smoke is thick and obscuring.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Creates a cloud of smoke that obscures vision in a 5-meter radius for 5 seconds.

name: Phantom Dodge
subtitle: Veilrunner skill
description: Enhances reflexes and body control, allowing the user to dodge attacks with minimal movement. At its most basic, the dodge provides a moderate boost to evasion. The user's movements become fluid and unpredictable.

fields.label: Effect
fields.value: Automatically dodges the next attack with 100% success rate. 10-second cooldown.

name: Poison Blade
subtitle: Veilrunner skill
description: Coats a blade in Ren-enhanced poison that slows, weakens, or paralyzes on contact. At its most basic, the poison causes minor weakness and slows the target briefly. The blade glows faintly with a sickly green light.

fields.label: Effect
